descriptionByLocale.it:
The Senior Program Manager will drive workstream landscape analyses, stakeholder mapping, and partner scoping in three countries, and support partner clinics in testing the Clinic Assessment Framework. You`ll also provide broader support to the portfolio team and coordinate HTWF's volunteering activities.

Portfolio Team Support

•
Provide broader program management support across the HTWF portfolio, including partner scouting, assessments, and ongoing monitoring as needed.

•
Support budget tracking, invoicing, and expense monitoring related to program activities.

•
Support organizing and coordinating volunteering opportunities for HTWF, matching volunteer skills and availability to partner and program needs.

Country Landscape Analyses (3 countries)

•
Manage the end-to-end consultant assignments for ear and hearing care landscape analyses, stakeholder mapping and partner scoping in three priority countries, using an established model.

•
Oversee inception, national- and sub-national-level desk review, key informant interviews, stakeholder mapping and partner assessment deliverables, ensuring quality and adherence to timelines and budget.

•
Present landscape analysis findings and recommendations to HTWF staff and support follow-up decision-making on new country and partner engagements

Please note that this role is offered temporarily for 12 months, from October 2026 to October 2027.

More about what we offer

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Forma il futuro di come milioni di persone sperimentano l'udito A Sonova, crediamo che le soluzioni uditive eccezionali siano molto più che tecnologie eccezionali: si tratta di creare prodotti che le persone si fidano, si godano di indossare e si affidano ogni giorno. Come Direttore Anatomic e Acoustic Design RIC-BTE, guiderai lo sviluppo di sistemi di distribuzione audio Fit-and-Go attraverso il portafoglio strumenti acustici di Sonova, modellando soluzioni che combinano eccellenti prestazioni uditive con comfort, discrezione e facilità di utilizzo quotidiano. Traslando le esigenze del cliente, la diversità anatomica e l'intento del prodotto in soluzioni scalabili, affidabili e manufacturable, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel rafforzare la soddisfazione del cliente, la differenziazione del prodotto e il vantaggio competitivo di Sonova. Leader di un team di esperti altamente qualificati, lavorerai all'incrocio tra ingegneria, acustica, anatomia e design focalizzato sull'utente, collaborando in R&D globale per definire la prossima generazione di sistemi di distribuzione del suono per più marchi, prodotti e piattaforme tecnologiche. Ulteriori informazioni sul ruolo
• Condurre lo sviluppo di sistemi di distribuzione audio Fit-and-Go e soluzioni di accoppiamento acustico attraverso il portafoglio strumenti uditivi di Sonova, dal concept al rilascio dei prodotti.
• Forma soluzioni orientate al cliente che bilanciano le prestazioni dell'udito, indossando comfort, discrezione, durata e usabilità quotidiana, affrontando la diversità di anatomia dell'orecchio e le esigenze del cliente del mondo reale.
• Definire concetti scalabili e orientati alla piattaforma che consentono di riutilizzare prodotti, marchi e future generazioni tecnologiche.
• Collabora con Mechanical Design, Hardware Integration, Hearing Performance, Materials & Biological Safety, Industrial Design e altri team interfunzionali per garantire lo sviluppo e l'industrializzazione di prodotti di successo.
• Guidare l'innovazione traducendo le conoscenze dei clienti, gli apprendisti clinici e le tecnologie emergenti in soluzioni di prodotto differenziate che offrono un valore duraturo del cliente.
• Costruire, allenare e sviluppare un team globale altamente performante, promuovendo l'eccellenza tecnica, la collaborazione e lo sviluppo di capacità a lungo termine.
• Condurre il processo decisionale interfunzionale, bilanciare il valore del cliente, la fattibilità tecnica, la manufacturability e le priorità aziendali per portare al mercato soluzioni innovative.
• Campione di una cultura collaborativa che rafforza la proprietà della piattaforma, la condivisione della conoscenza e l'innovazione nell'organizzazione R&D globale di Sonova. Più di te Devo
• Sfondo di ingegneria con esperienza comprovata sviluppo di prodotti all'interno di un ambiente R&D complesso e multidisciplinare.
• Dimostrata esperienza di leadership costruzione, coaching e lo sviluppo di team tecnici altamente performanti in un'organizzazione internazionale multi-sito.
• Forte esperienza nello sviluppo di prodotti innovativi dal concetto attraverso l'industrializzazione e la produzione.
• Capacità comprovata di tradurre le esigenze dei clienti in soluzioni tecniche differenziate mentre bilanciano le prestazioni, la manifatabilità, la scalabilità e gli obiettivi aziendali.
• Sistemi di pensiero forti, mentalità strategica e la capacità di navigare complesse sfide tecniche e organizzative.
• Eccellente capacità di gestione e comunicazione degli stakeholder, con la capacità di influenzare le funzioni ingegneristiche, di prodotto, cliniche e aziendali.
• Passione per l'innovazione, lo sviluppo di prodotti orientati al cliente e la leadership collaborativa.
• competenze linguistiche fluenti. Che bello avere
• Conoscenza dell'acustica, dell'anatomia dell'orecchio, del design incentrato sull'utente e/o dello sviluppo di dispositivi medici.
• Leadership, sviluppo organizzativo o formazione di trasformazione.
• Conoscenza delle normative sui dispositivi medici e dei quadri di validazione.
• Esperienza con Jira, Confluence, strumenti di gestione del portafoglio e ambienti di sviluppo dei prodotti basati sui dati.
• competenze linguistiche tedesche. Maggiori informazioni su ciò che offriamo Come uno dei principali fornitori di servizi di assistenza acustica al mondo con sede in Svizzera, ci impegniamo a costruire una cultura inclusiva dove è possibile bilanciare una carriera di successo con la vostra vita al di fuori del lavoro attraverso il nostro modello di lavoro ibrido flessibile. Offriamo una vasta gamma di opportunità di formazione sia per lo sviluppo professionale che per quello personale, con forti opportunità di crescita sostenute dai piani di sviluppo individuali. Processo di applicazione Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, non vede l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione tramite la nostra piattaforma di applicazione del lavoro online, compreso il vostro CV e lettera di copertura. Per questa vacanza, saranno considerate solo applicazioni dirette. <div dir="auto" style=" larghezza:calc(100% - 16px)
descriptionByLocale.en:
Shape the future of how millions of people experience hearing

At Sonova, we believe exceptional hearing solutions are about much more than outstanding technology—they're about creating products people trust, enjoy wearing and rely on every day.

As Director Anatomic and Acoustic Design RIC-BTE, you'll lead the development of Fit-and-Go sound delivery systems across Sonova's hearing instrument portfolio, shaping solutions that combine excellent hearing performance with wearing comfort, discretion and ease of everyday use. By translating customer needs, anatomical diversity and product intent into scalable, reliable and manufacturable solutions, you'll play a key role in strengthening customer satisfaction, product differentiation and Sonova's competitive advantage.

Leading a team of highly skilled experts, you'll work at the intersection of engineering, acoustics, anatomy and user-centred design, collaborating across global R&D to define the next generation of sound delivery systems for multiple brands, products and technology platforms.

More about the role

• Lead the development of Fit-and-Go sound delivery systems and acoustic coupling solutions across Sonova's hearing instrument portfolio, from concept through product release.

• Shape customer-centric solutions that balance hearing performance, wearing comfort, discretion, durability and everyday usability while addressing the diversity of ear anatomy and real-world customer needs.

• Define scalable, platform-oriented concepts that enable reuse across products, brands and future technology generations.

• Partner closely with Mechanical Design, Hardware Integration, Hearing Performance, Materials & Biological Safety, Industrial Design and other cross-functional teams to ensure successful product development and industrialization.

• Drive innovation by translating customer insights, clinical learnings and emerging technologies into differentiated product solutions that deliver lasting customer value.

• Build, coach and develop a high-performing global team, fostering technical excellence, collaboration and long-term capability development.

• Lead cross-functional decision-making, balancing customer value, technical feasibility, manufacturability and business priorities to successfully bring innovative solutions to market.

• Champion a collaborative culture that strengthens platform ownership, knowledge sharing and innovation across Sonova's global R&D organization.

More about you

Must have

• Engineering background with proven experience leading product development within a complex, multidisciplinary R&D environment.

• Demonstrated leadership experience building, coaching and developing high-performing technical teams in an international, multi-site organization.

• Strong experience developing innovative products from concept through industrialization and manufacturing.

• Proven ability to translate customer needs into differentiated technical solutions while balancing performance, manufacturability, scalability and business objectives.

• Strong systems thinking, strategic mindset and the ability to navigate complex technical and organizational challenges.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence across engineering, product, clinical and business functions.

• Passion for innovation, customer-centric product development and collaborative leadership.

• Fluent English language skills.

Nice to have

• Knowledge of acoustics, ear anatomy, user-centred design and/or medical device development.

• Leadership, organizational development or transformation training.

• Knowledge of medical device regulations and validation frameworks.

• Experience with Jira, Confluence, portfolio management tools and data-driven product development environments.

• German language skills.

More about what we offer

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we are committed to building an inclusive culture where you can balance a successful career with your life outside of work through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both professional and personal development, with strong growth opportunities supported by individual development plans.

Application process

Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, is looking forward to receiving your application via our online job application platform, including your CV and cover letter. For this vacancy, only direct applications will be considered.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Gestalten Sie die Zukunft, wie Millionen von Menschen Hören erleben Bei Sonova glauben wir, dass außergewöhnliche Hörlösungen viel mehr sind als herausragende Technologie - es geht darum, Produkte zu entwickeln, denen Menschen vertrauen, die sie gerne tragen und auf die sie sich jeden Tag verlassen. Als Director Anatomic and Acoustic Design RIC-BTE leiten Sie die Entwicklung von Fit-and-Go-Sound-Delivery-Systemen im gesamten Hörinstrumentenportfolio von Sonova und gestalten Lösungen, die eine hervorragende Hörleistung mit Tragekomfort, Diskretion und einfacher alltäglicher Nutzung verbinden. Durch die Übersetzung von Kundenbedürfnissen, anatomischer Vielfalt und Produktabsicht in skalierbare, zuverlässige und herstellbare Lösungen spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Stärkung der Kundenzufriedenheit, der Produktdifferenzierung und des Wettbewerbsvorteils von Sonova. Führen Sie ein Team von hochqualifizierten Experten, arbeiten Sie an der Schnittstelle von Engineering, Akustik, Anatomie und benutzerzentriertem Design und arbeiten in der globalen Forschung und Entwicklung zusammen, um die nächste Generation von Sound Delivery Systemen für mehrere Marken, Produkte und Technologieplattformen zu definieren. Mehr über die Rolle
• Führen Sie die Entwicklung von Fit-and-Go-Soundliefersystemen und akustischen Kopplungslösungen im gesamten Hörinstrumentenportfolio von Sonova, vom Konzept bis zur Produktfreigabe.
• Gestalten Sie kundenorientierte Lösungen, die Hörleistung, Tragekomfort, Diskretion, Langlebigkeit und Alltagstauglichkeit in Einklang bringen und gleichzeitig die Vielfalt der Ohranatomie und der realen Kundenbedürfnisse berücksichtigen.
• Definieren Sie skalierbare, plattformorientierte Konzepte, die eine Wiederverwendung über Produkte, Marken und zukünftige Technologiegenerationen hinweg ermöglichen.
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Mechanical Design, Hardware-Integration, Hörleistung, Materialien & biologische Sicherheit, Industriedesign und anderen funktionsübergreifenden Teams, um eine erfolgreiche Produktentwicklung und Industrialisierung sicherzustellen.
• Förderung von Innovationen durch die Übersetzung von Customer Insights, klinischem Lernen und neuen Technologien in differenzierte Produktlösungen, die einen dauerhaften Kundennutzen liefern.
• Aufbau, Coach und Entwicklung eines leistungsstarken globalen Teams, das technische Exzellenz, Zusammenarbeit und langfristige Entwicklung von Fähigkeiten fördert.
• Führen Sie funktionsübergreifende Entscheidungen, die Abwägung von Kundenwert, technischer Machbarkeit, Herstellbarkeit und Geschäftsprioritäten, um innovative Lösungen erfolgreich auf den Markt zu bringen.
• Verfechten Sie eine kollaborative Kultur, die den Besitz von Plattformen, den Wissensaustausch und die Innovation in der globalen F & E-Organisation von Sonova stärkt. Mehr über dich Muss haben
• Engineering Hintergrund mit nachgewiesener Erfahrung führende Produktentwicklung in einem komplexen, multidisziplinären R & D-Umgebung.
• Demonstrierte Führungserfahrung beim Aufbau, Coaching und der Entwicklung leistungsstarker technischer Teams in einer internationalen Organisation mit mehreren Standorten.
• Starke Erfahrung in der Entwicklung innovativer Produkte vom Konzept bis zur Industrialisierung und Fertigung.
• Bewährte Fähigkeit, Kundenbedürfnisse in differenzierte technische Lösungen zu übersetzen und dabei Leistung, Herstellbarkeit, Skalierbarkeit und Geschäftsziele auszugleichen.
• Starkes Systemdenken, strategisches Mindset und die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische und organisatorische Herausforderungen zu meistern.
• Hervorragende Stakeholder-Management- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Einfluss auf Engineering-, Produkt-, klinische und geschäftliche Funktionen zu nehmen.
• Leidenschaft für Innovation, kundenorientierte Produktentwicklung und kollaborative Führung.
• fließende Englischkenntnisse. Nizza zu haben
• Kenntnisse der Akustik, der Ohranatomie, des benutzerzentrierten Designs und/oder der Entwicklung medizinischer Geräte.
• Führung, Organisationsentwicklung oder Transformationstraining.
• Kenntnis der Vorschriften für Medizinprodukte und Validierungsrahmen.
• Erfahrung mit Jira, Confluence, Portfoliomanagement-Tools und datengesteuerten Produktentwicklungsumgebungen.
• Deutschkenntnisse. Mehr über das, was wir anbieten Als einer der weltweit führenden Hörgeräteanbieter mit Hauptsitz in der Schweiz setzen wir uns für den Aufbau einer integrativen Kultur ein, in der Sie durch unser flexibles hybrides Arbeitsmodell eine erfolgreiche Karriere mit Ihrem Leben außerhalb der Arbeit in Einklang bringen können. Wir bieten eine breite Palette von Ausbildungsmöglichkeiten für die berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung, mit starken Wachstumschancen durch individuelle Entwicklungspläne unterstützt. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Former l'avenir de l'expérience auditive de millions de personnes Chez Sonova, nous croyons que les solutions auditives exceptionnelles sont beaucoup plus qu'une technologie exceptionnelle : elles visent à créer des produits en confiance, à apprécier le port et à compter sur tous les jours. En tant que directeur de la conception anatomique et acoustique RIC-BTE, vous dirigerez le développement de systèmes de diffusion audio Fit-and-Go dans le portefeuille d'instruments auditifs de Sonova, façonnant des solutions qui allient une excellente performance auditive au confort, à la discrétion et à la facilité d'utilisation quotidienne. En traduisant les besoins des clients, la diversité anatomique et l'intention des produits en solutions évolutives, fiables et manufacturables, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le renforcement de la satisfaction des clients, de la différenciation des produits et de l'avantage concurrentiel de Sonova. Dirigez une équipe d'experts hautement qualifiés, vous travaillerez à l'intersection de l'ingénierie, de l'acoustique, de l'anatomie et de la conception axée sur l'utilisateur, en collaborant à travers la R-D mondiale pour définir la prochaine génération de systèmes de diffusion sonores pour plusieurs marques, produits et plateformes technologiques. En savoir plus sur le rôle
• Dirigez le développement de systèmes de diffusion audio Fit-and-Go et de solutions de couplage acoustique dans le portefeuille d'instruments auditifs de Sonova, du concept à la sortie du produit.
• Formez des solutions centrées sur le client qui équilibrent les performances auditives, le confort, la discrétion, la durabilité et la convivialité quotidienne tout en répondant à la diversité de l'anatomie des oreilles et aux besoins des clients du monde réel.
• Définir des concepts évolutifs axés sur les plateformes qui permettent la réutilisation entre les produits, les marques et les générations technologiques futures.
• Partenaire en étroite collaboration avec la conception mécanique, l'intégration du matériel, la performance auditive, la sécurité des matériaux et de la biologie, la conception industrielle et d'autres équipes interfonctionnelles pour assurer le succès du développement et de l'industrialisation des produits.
• Conduire l'innovation en traduisant les connaissances des clients, les apprentissages cliniques et les technologies émergentes en solutions de produits différenciées offrant une valeur client durable.
• Créer, entraîner et développer une équipe mondiale performante, favorisant l'excellence technique, la collaboration et le développement des capacités à long terme.
• Diriger la prise de décisions interfonctionnelles, équilibrer la valeur du client, la faisabilité technique, la fabrication et les priorités commerciales afin d'apporter des solutions innovantes au marché.
• Promouvoir une culture de collaboration qui renforce l'appropriation des plateformes, le partage des connaissances et l'innovation dans l'ensemble de l'organisation mondiale de R-D de Sonova. Plus sur vous Ça doit avoir
• Expérience en génie ayant fait ses preuves en matière de développement de produits dans un environnement complexe et multidisciplinaire de R-D.
• Expérience de leadership démontrée en matière de formation, de coaching et de développement d'équipes techniques performantes dans une organisation internationale multi-site.
• Forte expérience de développement de produits innovants du concept à l'industrialisation et à la fabrication.
• Capacité éprouvée de traduire les besoins du client en solutions techniques différenciées tout en équilibrage des performances, de la fabrication, de l'évolutivité et des objectifs commerciaux.
• Une réflexion solide sur les systèmes, l'état d'esprit stratégique et la capacité de relever des défis techniques et organisationnels complexes.
• Excellentes compétences en gestion des intervenants et en communication, avec la capacité d'influencer les fonctions d'ingénierie, de produit, clinique et commerciale.
• Passion d'innovation, développement de produits axés sur le client et leadership collaboratif.
• Compétences linguistiques en anglais. Sympa d'avoir
• Connaissance de l'acoustique, de l'anatomie des oreilles, de la conception axée sur l'utilisateur et/ou du développement d'un appareil médical.
• Formation en leadership, développement organisationnel ou transformation.
• Connaissance des règlements sur les instruments médicaux et des cadres de validation.
• Expérience avec Jira, Confluence, outils de gestion de portefeuille et environnements de développement de produits axés sur les données.
• Compétences linguistiques en allemand. Plus sur ce que nous offrons Comme l'un des principaux fournisseurs de soins auditifs basés en Suisse, nous nous engageons à construire une culture inclusive où vous pouvez équilibrer une carrière réussie avec votre vie en dehors du travail grâce à notre modèle de travail hybride flexible. Nous offrons un large éventail de possibilités de formation pour le perfectionnement professionnel et personnel, avec de fortes possibilités de croissance soutenues par des plans de perfectionnement individuels. Processus de demande Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, est impatiente de recevoir votre candidature via notre plateforme d'application en ligne, y compris votre CV et lettre de motivation. Pour ce poste vacant, seules les candidatures directes seront examinées. <div dir="auto" style=" largeur:calc(100% - 16px) !important;"

descriptionByLocale.it:
Scopo del lavoro

Process Engineer responsabile della modellazione del futuro della produzione presso l'OC locale guidando l'automazione, la digitalizzazione e le tecnologie emergenti. Supporta e industrializza processi produttivi automatizzati e semi-automatizzati, esplorando e convalidando soluzioni di nuova generazione come la produzione guidata dall'IA, la robotica avanzata, i robot umanoidi, la gestione autonoma dei materiali e le tecnologie di fabbrica intelligenti. Agisce come catalizzatore per l'innovazione, garantendo la prontezza della produzione per le sfide e le opportunità di produzione future.

Compiti e responsabilità

• Responsabile per il supporto di produzione di primo e secondo livello presso SOCS, mantenendo, controllando e avanzando continuamente processi di produzione automatizzati e semi-automatici, tra cui lavorazione laser, assemblaggio SMT, erogazione, sottoriempimento, jetting, curing, laccatura e tecnologie di rivestimento. Guida l'adozione di avanzate soluzioni di automazione, smart manufacturing e tecnologie di processo digitali per migliorare le prestazioni operative.

• Responsabile per l'ottimizzazione della qualità di produzione, dei costi, delle prestazioni di consegna e del rendimento grazie al continuo miglioramento dei processi produttivi e dei prodotti. Conduce e sostiene iniziative di automazione, digitalizzazione e innovazione come task o project manager e soggetto esperto, tra cui Change Plan Owner, Special Batch Owner e responsabilità ISIR.

• Esegui le indagini tecniche, le attività di convalida dei processi e documentazione. Sviluppa e realizza concetti di formazione per operatori e team tecnici, promuovendo l'implementazione di nuove tecnologie di produzione, soluzioni di automazione e best practice

• Responsabile per la risoluzione tempestiva di problemi di equipaggiamento, processo e non conformità dei prodotti. Utilizza metodologie data-driven e tecniche avanzate di monitoraggio dei processi per migliorare l'affidabilità delle apparecchiature, la capacità di processo e la robustezza di produzione (i rulli includono NC Owner e NC Action Owner).

• Collabora con l'introduzione, l'industrializzazione e lo scaling di nuovi prodotti, processi e tecnologie di produzione, nonché il trasferimento dei processi produttivi in siti globali. Supporta l'implementazione di robotica avanzata, sistemi abilitati all'intelligenza artificiale, visione della macchina, soluzioni di produzione autonome e futuri concetti di fabbrica intelligente.

• Proattivamente esplora, valuta e pilota le tecnologie di produzione emergenti, tra cui robotica avanzata, robot umanoidi, automazione AI-driven, sistemi di gestione dei materiali autonomi e soluzioni Industry 4.0, valutandone l'applicabilità alla produzione di apparecchi acustici e medicali.

• Agisce come campione di tecnologia all'interno di SOCS, individuando opportunità per sfruttare i concetti di produzione innovativi per migliorare produttività, flessibilità, qualità e sostenibilità, garantendo al tempo stesso la disponibilità futura delle operazioni di produzione.

Qualifiche

• Laurea o master in ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria meccanica, meccatronica, ingegneria dell'automazione, robotica, ingegneria manifatturiera o scienza dei materiali

• Istruzione nella gestione dei progetti

• Miglioramento continuo e metodologie di problem-solving

• Esperienza in ambienti di produzione automatizzati e semiautomatici

• Esperienza nella produzione elettronica, dispositivi medici o altre industrie altamente regolamentate

• Esperienza nell'ottimizzazione dei processi e nell'industrializzazione

• Impegnata, automotivata e orientata alla qualità

• Modo di lavoro strutturato e analitico

• Capacità di comprendere e gestire sistemi tecnici complessi

• Mindset orientato alla soluzione con forti capacità di risoluzione dei problemi

• Curiosità e volontà di esplorare tecnologie emergenti e concetti di produzione innovativi

• Forte competenza tecnica nella produzione elettronica e/o nella produzione di dispositivi medici

• Conoscenza del processo di produzione validazione, analisi dei rischi e ambienti regolamentati

• Comprensione delle tecnologie di automazione e delle attrezzature industriali

• Forte problem-solving e radici competenze di analisi

• Lingue: tedesco e inglese / fluente parlare e scrivere è obbligatorio.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Purpose of the Job

Process Engineer responsible for shaping the future of manufacturing at the local OC by driving automation, digitalization and emerging technologies. Supports and industrializes automated and semi-automated production processes while exploring and validating next-generation solutions such as AI-driven manufacturing, advanced robotics, humanoid robots, autonomous material handling and smart factory technologies. Acts as a catalyst for innovation, ensuring production readiness for future manufacturing challenges and opportunities.

Tasks & Responsibilities

• Responsible for first- and second-level production support at SOCS by maintaining, controlling and continuously advancing automated and semi-automated manufacturing processes, including laser processing, SMT assembly, dispensing, underfill, jetting, curing, lacquering and coating technologies. Drives the adoption of advanced automation, smart manufacturing solutions and digital process technologies to enhance operational performance.

• Responsible for optimizing manufacturing quality, cost, delivery performance and yield through continuous improvement of production processes and products. Leads and supports automation, digitalization and innovation initiatives as task or project manager and subject matter expert, including Change Plan Owner, Special Batch Owner and ISIR Owner responsibilities.

• Performs technical investigations, process validation and documentation activities. Develops and delivers training concepts for operators and technical teams while promoting the implementation of new manufacturing technologies, automation solutions and best practices

• Responsible for the timely resolution of equipment, process and product non-conformance issues. Utilizes data-driven methodologies and advanced process monitoring techniques to improve equipment reliability, process capability and manufacturing robustness (roles include NC Owner and NC Action Owner).

• Collaborates in the introduction, industrialization and scaling of new products, processes and manufacturing technologies, as well as the transfer of production processes across global sites. Supports the deployment of advanced robotics, AI-enabled systems, machine vision, autonomous manufacturing solutions and future smart factory concepts.

• Proactively scouts, evaluates and pilots emerging manufacturing technologies, including advanced robotics, humanoid robots, AI-driven automation, autonomous material handling systems and Industry 4.0 solutions, assessing their applicability to hearing aid and medical device manufacturing.

• Acts as a technology champion within SOCS, identifying opportunities to leverage innovative manufacturing concepts to improve productivity, flexibility, quality and sustainability while ensuring future readiness of manufacturing operations.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, Robotics, Manufacturing Engineering or Material Science

• Education in Project Management

• Continuous Improvement and Problem-Solving methodologies

• Experience in automated and semi-automated manufacturing environments

• Experience in electronics manufacturing, medical devices or other highly regulated industries

• Experience in process optimization and industrialization

• Committed, self-motivated and quality-oriented

• Structured and analytical way of working

• Ability to understand and manage complex technical systems

• Solution-oriented mindset with strong troubleshooting capabilities

• Curiosity and willingness to explore emerging technologies and innovative manufacturing concepts

• Strong technical expertise in electronics manufacturing and/or medical device production

• Knowledge of manufacturing process validation, risk analysis and regulated environments

• Understanding of automation technologies and industrial equipment

• Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills

• Languages: German and English / Fluent speaking and writing is mandatory.

Zweck des Auftrags

Prozessingenieur verantwortlich für die Gestaltung der Zukunft der Fertigung im lokalen OC durch Automatisierung, Digitalisierung und neue Technologien. Unterstützt und industrialisiert automatisierte und halbautomatische Produktionsprozesse und erforscht und validiert Lösungen der nächsten Generation wie KI-gesteuerte Fertigung, fortschrittliche Robotik, humanoide Roboter, autonomes Materialhandling und intelligente Fabriktechnologien. Funktioniert als Katalysator für Innovationen und stellt die Produktionsbereitschaft für zukünftige Herausforderungen und Chancen in der Fertigung sicher.

Aufgaben & Verantwortlichkeiten

• Verantwortlich für die First- und Second-Level-Produktionsunterstützung bei SOCS durch die Aufrechterhaltung, Steuerung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung automatisierter und halbautomatischer Fertigungsprozesse, einschließlich Laserbearbeitung, SMT-Montage, Dispensieren, Unterfüllen, Spritzen, Aushärten, Lackieren und Beschichtungstechnologien. Fördert die Einführung von fortschrittlicher Automatisierung, intelligenten Fertigungslösungen und digitalen Prozesstechnologien zur Verbesserung der Betriebsleistung.

• Verantwortlich für die Optimierung der Fertigungsqualität, Kosten, Lieferleistung und Ausbeute durch kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Produktionsprozesse und Produkte. Leitet und unterstützt Automatisierungs-, Digitalisierungs- und Innovationsinitiativen als Task- oder Projektmanager und Fachexperte, einschließlich Change Plan Owner, Special Batch Owner und ISIR Owner.

• Führt technische Untersuchungen, Prozessvalidierung und Dokumentation durch. Entwickelt und liefert Schulungskonzepte für Bediener und technische Teams und fördert die Implementierung neuer Fertigungstechnologien, Automatisierungslösungen und Best Practices

• Verantwortlich für die rechtzeitige Lösung von Nichtkonformitätsproblemen bei Geräten, Prozessen und Produkten. Verwendet datengesteuerte Methoden und fortschrittliche Prozessüberwachungstechniken, um die Zuverlässigkeit der Ausrüstung, die Prozessfähigkeit und die Robustheit der Fertigung zu verbessern (Rollen umfassen NC Owner und NC Action Owner).

• Kooperiert bei der Einführung, Industrialisierung und Skalierung neuer Produkte, Prozesse und Fertigungstechnologien sowie der Übertragung von Produktionsprozessen über globale Standorte hinweg. Unterstützt den Einsatz von fortschrittlicher Robotik, KI-fähigen Systemen, Machine Vision, autonomen Fertigungslösungen und zukünftigen Smart-Factory-Konzepten.

• Erforscht, bewertet und pilotiert proaktiv neue Fertigungstechnologien, einschließlich fortschrittlicher Robotik, humanoider Roboter, KI-gesteuerter Automatisierung, autonomer Materialhandling-Systeme und Industrie 4.0-Lösungen, und bewertet ihre Anwendbarkeit auf die Herstellung von Hörgeräten und medizinischen Geräten.

• Agiert als Technologie-Champion innerhalb von SOCS und identifiziert Möglichkeiten, innovative Fertigungskonzepte zu nutzen, um Produktivität, Flexibilität, Qualität und Nachhaltigkeit zu verbessern und gleichzeitig die zukünftige Bereitschaft der Fertigungsbetriebe zu gewährleisten.

Qualifikationen

• Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau, Mechatronik, Automatisierungstechnik, Robotik, Fertigungstechnik oder Materialwissenschaften

• Ausbildung im Projektmanagement

• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung und Problemlösungsmethoden

• Erfahrung in automatisierten und halbautomatischen Fertigungsumgebungen

• Erfahrung in der Elektronikfertigung, medizinischen Geräten oder anderen hochregulierten Industrien

• Erfahrung in Prozessoptimierung und Industrialisierung

• Engagiert, selbstmotiviert und qualitätsorientiert

• Strukturierte und analytische Arbeitsweise

• Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Systeme zu verstehen und zu verwalten

• Lösungsorientierte Denkweise mit starken Fähigkeiten zur Fehlerbehebung

• Neugier und Bereitschaft, neue Technologien und innovative Fertigungskonzepte zu erforschen

• Starkes technisches Know-how in der Elektronikfertigung und/oder Produktion von Medizinprodukten

• Kenntnisse der Validierung von Herstellungsprozessen, Risikoanalysen und regulierten Umgebungen

• Verständnis von Automatisierungstechnologien und Industrieanlagen

• Starke Fähigkeiten zur Problemlösung und Ursachenanalyse

Objet du travail

Ingénieur de process responsable de façonner l'avenir de la fabrication à l'OC local en conduisant l'automatisation, la numérisation et les technologies émergentes. Soutient et industrialise les processus de production automatisés et semi-automatisés tout en explorant et en validant des solutions de nouvelle génération telles que la fabrication assistée par l'IA, la robotique avancée, les robots humanoïdes, la manipulation autonome des matériaux et les technologies d'usine intelligente. Agir comme catalyseur de l'innovation, en assurant la préparation de la production aux défis et aux possibilités futurs de fabrication.

Tâches et responsabilités

• Responsable du soutien à la production de premier et deuxième niveaux chez SOCS en maintenant, en contrôlant et en faisant progresser en permanence les procédés de fabrication automatisés et semi-automatisés, y compris le traitement au laser, l'assemblage SMT, la distribution, le sous-remplissage, le jettage, le durcissement, le laquage et le revêtement. Elle favorise l'adoption de solutions d'automatisation, de fabrication intelligente et de technologies numériques pour améliorer les performances opérationnelles.

• Responsable de l'optimisation de la qualité de fabrication, des coûts, des performances de livraison et du rendement grâce à l'amélioration continue des procédés de production et des produits. Dirige et appuie les initiatives d'automatisation, de numérisation et d'innovation à titre de gestionnaire de tâches ou de projets et d'expert en la matière, y compris les responsabilités du propriétaire du plan de changement, du propriétaire du lot spécial et du propriétaire de l'ISIR.

• Effectue des enquêtes techniques, des activités de validation des processus et de documentation. Développer et fournir des concepts de formation pour les opérateurs et les équipes techniques tout en favorisant la mise en œuvre des nouvelles technologies de fabrication, des solutions d'automatisation et des meilleures pratiques

• Responsable de la résolution rapide des problèmes de non-conformité de l'équipement, des procédés et des produits. Utilise des méthodes fondées sur les données et des techniques avancées de surveillance des processus pour améliorer la fiabilité de l'équipement, la capacité de traitement et la robustesse de fabrication (les rôles comprennent le propriétaire NC et le propriétaire NC Action).

• Collabore à l'introduction, à l'industrialisation et à l'expansion de nouveaux produits, procédés et technologies de fabrication, ainsi qu'au transfert de procédés de production sur des sites mondiaux. Soutient le déploiement de robotique avancée, de systèmes compatibles avec l'IA, de la vision de la machine, de solutions de fabrication autonomes et de futurs concepts d'usine intelligente.

• Détecte, évalue et pilote de manière proactive les nouvelles technologies de fabrication, notamment la robotique avancée, les robots humanoïdes, l'automatisation axée sur l'IA, les systèmes autonomes de manutention des matériaux et les solutions de l'Industrie 4.0, en évaluant leur applicabilité aux appareils auditifs et à la fabrication d'appareils médicaux.

• Agir en tant que champion de la technologie au sein de la SOCS, identifier les occasions de tirer parti de concepts de fabrication novateurs pour améliorer la productivité, la flexibilité, la qualité et la durabilité tout en assurant la préparation future des opérations de fabrication.

Compétences

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en génie électrique, génie mécanique, mécatronique, ingénierie d'automatisation, robotique, génie manufacturier ou sciences des matériaux

• Éducation à la gestion de projets

• Amélioration continue et méthodes de résolution des problèmes

• Expérience dans les environnements de fabrication automatisés et semi-automatisés

• Expérience dans la fabrication d'appareils électroniques, de dispositifs médicaux ou d'autres industries hautement réglementées

• Expérience en optimisation des procédés et en industrialisation

• Engagement, motivation et qualité

• Mode de travail structuré et analytique

• Capacité de comprendre et de gérer des systèmes techniques complexes

• Un état d'esprit axé sur la solution avec de fortes capacités de dépannage

• Curiosité et volonté d'explorer les technologies émergentes et les concepts de fabrication innovants

• Forte expertise technique dans la fabrication d'appareils électroniques et/ou médicaux

• Connaissance de la validation des procédés de fabrication, de l'analyse des risques et des environnements réglementés

• Compréhension des technologies d'automatisation et des équipements industriels

• Fortes compétences en résolution de problèmes et en analyse des causes profondes

• Langues: Allemand et anglais / parler et écrire couramment est obligatoire.

descriptionByLocale.it:
The Director, Performance Management & Capabilities Building is a strategic leader responsible for defining and executing Sonova’s global learning, performance management, and talent development strategies. This role oversees the design and implementation of the Academies framework, coaching and mentoring programmes—including AI-enabled approaches—graduate development, and scalable learning offerings that build organisational capability at all levels. Accountable for shaping and embedding a robust performance management framework, this role partners closely with senior leaders to drive goal setting and talent development for Sonova’s Top 200+ leaders, ensuring alignment with business priorities and leadership standards. The Director leads flagship talent development programmes, individual career journey design, and the talent review process, fostering a culture of continuous growth and high performance. This role ensures integration and alignment of learning and performance initiatives with broader talent functions such as talent acquisition, culture transformation, and Org E&E. The Director also collaborates with HR Strategy to develop and maintain a comprehensive skills architecture and taxonomy that supports Sonova’s evolving capability needs. In this role, you will: Lead Learning and Academies
• Define, develop, and oversee the global Academies framework and its implementation to build critical capabilities across Sonova.
• Design and deliver coaching and mentoring programmes, incorporating AI-enabled tools and approaches to enhance learning effectiveness.

• Own and continuously evolve Sonova’s performance management framework, ensuring alignment with organisational goals and leadership expectations.
• Lead goal-setting processes for the Top 200 leaders, fostering accountability and clear performance expectations.
• Partner with HR and business leaders to embed performance management practices that drive high performance and development. Talent Development and Career Journey Design
• Lead the design and execution of individual career journeys for Sonova’s Top 200 talent, supporting personalised growth and succession planning.
• Oversee flagship talent development programmes, including approach design, assessment methodologies, and delivery.
• Develop and implement people leadership standards and related development programmes to strengthen leadership capabilities across the organisation. Talent Review and Succession Processes
• Manage the talent review approach and processes, ensuring robust assessment and calibration of talent across business units.
• Collaborate with HR Strategy and Org E&E team to align talent development efforts with organisational capability needs and succession plans. Skills Architecture and Taxonomy
• Partner with HR Strategy to develop, maintain, and evolve a comprehensive skills architecture and taxonomy that supports workforce planning and capability building.
• Ensure skills frameworks are integrated into learning, performance management, and talent development initiatives. Stakeholder Engagement and Collaboration
• Work closely with business leaders, HR Business Partners, and the Talent Centre of Excellence to ensure learning and performance strategies are aligned with business priorities.
• Collaborate with external partners, including business schools and learning providers, to enhance programme quality and innovation.
• Manage vendor relationships and oversee quality management systems for external learning and assessment providers. Innovation and Continuous Improvement
• Champion a culture of continuous learning and development, leveraging digital and multimedia solutions to maximise reach and impact.
• Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness, adoption, and compliance of learning and performance programmes, using data to drive improvements.
• Stay abreast of industry trends and best practices to ensure Sonova remains a leader in leadership development and talent management. Your Profile:
• 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in global learning, leadership development, and performance management, with a proven track record of designing and scaling high-impact talent development programmes in complex, matrixed organisations.
• Master’s degree in Psychology, Human Resources, Business, or a related field; formal training or qualification in talent development or coaching is highly desirable.
• Ability to develop and execute integrated learning and performance strategies that align with business objectives, drive organisational transformation, and foster a culture of continuous development and high performance.
• Deep knowledge of leadership models, coaching methodologies (including AI-enabled coaching), and talent development frameworks, with experience leading flagship programmes for senior and emerging leaders.
• Strong analytical skills with expertise in leveraging learning analytics, programme evaluation, and performance data to inform strategy, optimise learning experiences, and demonstrate measurable business impact.
• Exceptional stakeholder management and internal consulting skills, with a proven ability to influence senior executives and cross-functional leaders, champion change initiatives, and navigate organisational complexity with agility and resilience.
• Skilled in designing blended learning solutions that incorporate digital, experiential, and social learning modalities at scale, utilising cutting-edge technologies and platforms to enhance engagement and accessibility.
• Experience leading diverse, geographically dispersed teams and programmes across multiple regions (EMEA, Americas, APAC), with sensitivity to cultural nuances and local market dynamics.
• Proven capability in managing budgets, vendor relationships, and quality assurance processes to deliver cost-effective, scalable, and compliant learning and performance management solutions.
• Expertise in learning management systems (e.g., SuccessFactors) and other digital tools that support learning analytics and talent development
• Outstanding communication, presentation, and facilitation skills, capable of engaging and inspiring audiences at all organisational levels, from store sales employees to C-suite executives
• Proven experience designing and implementing diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives within learning and talent development strategies to build inclusive leadership capabilities.
• Experience working within a corporate headquarters environment, collaborating closely with HR Centres of Excellence, business leaders, and external partners such as business schools and learning providers
• English is a must; proficiency in multiple languages is an asset. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans. • Collaborate with external partners, including business schools and learning providers, to enhance programme quality and innovation.

Innovation and Continuous Improvement

• Champion a culture of continuous learning and development, leveraging digital and multimedia solutions to maximise reach and impact.

• Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness, adoption, and compliance of learning and performance programmes, using data to drive improvements.

• Stay abreast of industry trends and best practices to ensure Sonova remains a leader in leadership development and talent management.

• 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in global learning, leadership development, and performance management, with a proven track record of designing and scaling high-impact talent development programmes in complex, matrixed organisations.

• Strong analytical skills with expertise in leveraging learning analytics, programme evaluation, and performance data to inform strategy, optimise learning experiences, and demonstrate measurable business impact.

• Exceptional stakeholder management and internal consulting skills, with a proven ability to influence senior executives and cross-functional leaders, champion change initiatives, and navigate organisational complexity with agility and resilience.

• Skilled in designing blended learning solutions that incorporate digital, experiential, and social learning modalities at scale, utilising cutting-edge technologies and platforms to enhance engagement and accessibility.

• Experience leading diverse, geographically dispersed teams and programmes across multiple regions (EMEA, Americas, APAC), with sensitivity to cultural nuances and local market dynamics.

• Proven capability in managing budgets, vendor relationships, and quality assurance processes to deliver cost-effective, scalable, and compliant learning and performance management solutions.

• Expertise in learning management systems (e.g., SuccessFactors) and other digital tools that support learning analytics and talent development

• Outstanding communication, presentation, and facilitation skills, capable of engaging and inspiring audiences at all organisational levels, from store sales employees to C-suite executives

• Proven experience designing and implementing diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives within learning and talent development strategies to build inclusive leadership capabilities.

• Experience working within a corporate headquarters environment, collaborating closely with HR Centres of Excellence, business leaders, and external partners such as business schools and learning providers

• English is a must; proficiency in multiple languages is an asset.

More about what we offer

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

For this vacancy, only direct applications will be considered.

title: Senior Manager Product Quality (m/f/d)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Aiuta a modellare come la qualità è ingegnerizzata in prodotti utilizzati da milioni di persone in tutto il mondo.

A Sonova, stiamo cercando un leader di affidabilità di qualità del prodotto esperto per possedere ed evolvere il nostro framework Critical-to-Quality (CtQ) globale per i nostri prodotti Hardware e SW, assicurando che le caratteristiche critiche del prodotto siano incorporate e verificate in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto.

Lavorando attraverso lo sviluppo del prodotto, la produzione, le operazioni, la qualità del fornitore e il servizio, si istituirà la governance CtQ globale, guidare la tracciabilità end-to-end e contribuire a modellare come le soluzioni acustiche innovative sono sviluppate sul ciclo di vita del prodotto completo.

Se vi piace costruire quadri, come le attività di ingegneria dell'affidabilità, formare le persone, lavorare insieme ad altri stakeholder e guidare un miglioramento continuo in un ambiente altamente regolamentato, ci piacerebbe sentire da voi.

Ulteriori informazioni sul ruolo

• Proprio e evolve continuamente il processo Critical-to-Quality globale di Sonova (CtQ), garantendo la sua implementazione e l'efficacia in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto.

• Stabilire e guidare la governance CtQ globale, gli standard e le migliori pratiche per lo sviluppo dei prodotti, la produzione, il fornitore e il servizio.

• Partner con i team di sviluppo del prodotto per garantire le caratteristiche di Critical-to-Quality e i principi di Reliability Engineering sono considerati dalle prime fasi di sviluppo del prodotto.

Maggiori informazioni su ciò che offriamo

descriptionByLocale.it:
Come operatore, si lavora nella produzione delle nostre innovative soluzioni uditive e componenti elettronici. Con l'artigianato, un occhio attento alla qualità e alla gioia del lavoro preciso, voi e il vostro team potete contribuire a creare prodotti che fanno la differenza per milioni di persone.

Ci si può aspettare un ambiente di produzione moderno e variegato – dal lavoro filigrano sotto il microscopio al montaggio e al controllo di qualità al funzionamento di impianti di produzione e test automatizzati.

L'esperienza di produzione è necessaria. Per noi, tuttavia, il fattore decisivo è la vostra motivazione, un modo attento di lavorare e la vostra volontà di imparare nuove cose e svilupparsi, così come la vostra volontà di lavorare in tre strati.

Ulteriori informazioni sui tuoi compiti

• Attuazione di lavori manuali precisi sugli apparecchi acustici e sugli assemblaggi elettronici, in parte sotto lo schermo o microscopio convenzionale

• Sticking, pittura, mascheramento e controlli di qualità visiva

• Funzionamento di impianti di produzione e di collaudo automatizzati e semiautomatici

• Imballaggio di apparecchi acustici, accessori, parti e componenti elettronici

• Garantire la corretta documentazione degli ordini di produzione e tempi di lavoro e ordine

• Rispetto ai nostri standard di qualità, sicurezza e lavoro e supporto per un processo produttivo affidabile ed efficiente

• Partecipazione attiva alle attività del negozio e miglioramenti continui, nonché supporto per altre aree di produzione necessarie

Più di te

• L'istruzione secondaria superiore I e II; la formazione professionale tecnica o l'ulteriore formazione è vantaggiosa

• Divertimento del lavoro motore preciso e fine nonché una forte qualità e consapevolezza della sicurezza

• Metodi di lavoro affidabili, attenti e strutturati, nonché flessibilità e disponibilità ad imparare

• Godimento di lavorare insieme in un team e un approccio aperto e costruttivo al feedback

• Conoscenza del tedesco almeno al livello B1 per poter comprendere in modo sicuro le istruzioni di lavoro e la documentazione di produzione. L'inglese è un vantaggio.

• Competenze PC di base; Esperienza con MS Office, SAP o applicazioni simili è un vantaggio

• L'esperienza in un ambiente di produzione – soprattutto nell'elettronica, nella tecnologia medica o nella produzione di precisione – così come le conoscenze nella saldatura, nelle attrezzature SMD o nel lavoro sotto il microscopio sono vantaggiose, ma non prerequisiti

Maggiori informazioni su ciò che offriamo

Come uno dei principali fornitori di soluzioni uditive al mondo, con sede in Svizzera, vi offriamo un ambiente di lavoro internazionale e innovativo in cui la qualità, la collaborazione e lo sviluppo continuo sono al centro.

Con noi, si lavora su prodotti di alta qualità che aiutano a migliorare la qualità della vita delle persone su base giornaliera. Riceverai una familiarizzazione strutturata e l'opportunità di sviluppare le tue competenze in diverse aree di produzione e costruire competenze aggiuntive.

Promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro in cui le persone possono assumersi la responsabilità, imparare l'un l'altro e avere successo insieme.

descriptionByLocale.en:
As an operator, you work in the production of our innovative hearing solutions and electronic components. With craftsmanship, a keen eye for quality and the joy of precise work, you and your team can help create products that make a difference for millions of people.

You can expect a modern and varied production environment – from filigree work under the microscope to assembly and quality control to the operation of automated production and testing facilities.

Production experience is required. For us, however, the decisive factor is your motivation, a careful way of working and your willingness to learn new things and develop yourself, as well as your willingness to work in three layers.

More about your tasks

• Implementation of precise manual work on hearing aids and electronic assemblies, partly under the screen or conventional microscope

• Sticking, painting, masking and visual quality controls

• Operation of automated and semi-automated production and testing facilities

• Packaging of hearing aids, accessories, parts and electronic components

• Ensuring correct documentation of production orders as well as working and order times

• Compliance with our quality, safety and labor standards and support for a reliable and efficient production process

• Active participation in shop floor activities and continuous improvements as well as support for other production areas as needed

More about you

• Higher secondary education I and II; technical vocational training or further training is advantageous

• Enjoyment of precise and fine motor work as well as a strong quality and safety awareness

• Reliable, careful and structured working methods as well as flexibility and willingness to learn

• Enjoyment of working together in a team and an open and constructive approach to feedback

• Knowledge of German at least at level B1 in order to be able to safely understand work instructions and production documentation. English is an advantage.

• Basic PC skills; Experience with MS Office, SAP or similar applications is an advantage

• Experience in a production environment – especially in electronics, medical technology or precision manufacturing – as well as knowledge in soldering, SMD equipment or working under the microscope are advantageous, but not a prerequisite

More about what we offer

As one of the world’s leading providers of hearing solutions, headquartered in Switzerland, we offer you an international and innovative working environment in which quality, collaboration and continuous development are the focus.

With us, you work on high-quality products that help to improve people’s quality of life on a daily basis. You will receive a structured familiarisation and the opportunity to develop your skills in different production areas and build up additional expertise.

We promote a working environment in which people can take responsibility, learn from each other and be successful together.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Shape the future of hearing care through innovative fitting software

At Sonova, we're redefining the future of hearing care through innovative fitting software. As Director Fitting Software Solutions, you will shape the future of Sonova's global fitting software ecosystem by leading the end-to-end delivery, integration and evolution of scalable, brand-agnostic fitting software applications used across multiple brands and regions. You will ensure our solutions deliver meaningful audiological value while meeting the highest standards of quality, scalability and regulatory compliance.

Working within our globally integrated R&D organization, you'll collaborate across engineering, product and business functions to drive predictable delivery of fitting software applications, enable technical excellence and influence the long-term evolution of Sonova's fitting software portfolio. In this highly visible leadership role, you'll help shape software solutions that empower hearing care professionals and improve the lives of millions of people with hearing loss worldwide.

More about the role

• Lead the end-to-end delivery of fitting software applications, from feature development through integration, stabilization and release readiness.

• Drive the integration, evolution and lifecycle management of fitting software applications and variants, ensuring scalable, robust and brand-agnostic solutions across global markets.

• Translate product priorities into executable delivery plans while managing dependencies, timelines, delivery risks and cross-functional trade-offs across multiple release trains.

• Ensure successful software integration, verification readiness, stabilization activities and release governance in close collaboration with System Integration, Platform & Component Software, Audiological, Development and Verification teams.

• Partner closely with Marketing, Brand teams and business stakeholders to deliver fitting software solutions that support global, regional and commercial priorities.

• Champion delivery governance, quality standards, regulatory compliance and continuous improvement throughout the software development lifecycle.

• Lead, develop and grow high-performing global engineering teams by fostering technical excellence, building organizational capability and developing future leaders.

More about you

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience in complex, regulated software development environments.

• Extensive experience in fitting software or related hearing system development, including software application delivery, integration and lifecycle management.

• Proven leadership experience delivering complex software solutions within multi-release, regulated product development environments.

• Demonstrated success leading cross-functional, international software engineering teams across multi-site and multi-brand organizations.

• Strong expertise in software delivery governance, release planning, dependency management, software lifecycle management and technical debt management.

• Strong systems thinking with the ability to navigate complex, multi-domain environments and balance quality, risk, scalability and business priorities while making sound technical and delivery trade-off decisions.

• Outstanding stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to build trust and alignment across engineering, marketing, audiology and business teams.

• Fluency in English.

Nice to have

• Knowledge of medical device regulations and software validation frameworks.

• Experience leading organizational transformation or working with data-informed product development and analytics platforms.

• Proficiency in German would be an advantage.

More about what we offer

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of hearing care technology by leading globally distributed engineering teams developing software solutions that improve the lives of millions of people with hearing loss. You'll work at the intersection of innovation, healthcare and technology while influencing the future of Sonova's global fitting software portfolio.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Se siete alla ricerca di un'opportunità di immergersi nel test hardware e software e ottenere esperienza pratica nelle sfide di verifica del mondo reale, questa opportunità è per voi.

Come stagista, si co-svilupperà una piattaforma di test progettata per convalidare sia le specifiche software che hardware a livello di sistema, coprendo il comportamento funzionale, la gestione della potenza e il test elettromeccanico.

Il vostro focus sarà sulla costruzione e il mantenimento dell'infrastruttura di prova per la ricarica di soluzioni, lo sviluppo di script di test automatizzati, e l'esecuzione di esperimenti per valutare il comportamento di carica in scenari di utilizzo realistici degli strumenti acustici. Si trasformeranno i dati di misura grezzi in report chiari e intuizioni attuabili.

Il vostro lavoro si estenderà a tutto il ciclo di vita di prova, e sarete parte di un team di ingegneria interfunzionale, dandovi l'esposizione diretta a reali sfide quotidiane in elettronica, firmware e prestazioni a livello di sistema - tutto nel contesto di tecnologia di apparecchi acustici innovativi.

Ulteriori informazioni sul ruolo

• Stabilire, calibrare, mantenere l'infrastruttura di prova per la verifica delle soluzioni di ricarica

• Sviluppare, mantenere ed eseguire script/framework di test automatizzati per eseguire piani di verifica

• Sviluppare casi di test per nuove funzionalità sviluppate e adattare i casi di test esistenti a nuove variazioni di prodotto

• Eseguire esperimenti per valutare il comportamento di carica e i meccanismi di sicurezza in scenari di utilizzo realistici degli strumenti acustici

• Collabora con i team ingegneristici su requisiti e strategie di test

• Raccogliere, analizzare e visualizzare i dati di misura, preparare report chiari e la documentazione delle procedure di prova e dei risultati.

• Supporto e risoluzione dei problemi delle impostazioni di misura e contribuire al miglioramento continuo dei flussi di lavoro di prova.

• Collabora con gli ingegneri sull'elettronica, il firmware, l'integrazione con i dispositivi acustici e le indagini sulle prestazioni a livello di sistema.

Più di te

• BSc o MSc in Ingegneria Elettrica o campo correlato

• Conoscenza di programmazione di base (Python, MATLAB, C)

• Knowhow nel test manuale e automatizzato dell'hardware e la risoluzione dei problemi dei dispositivi elettronici è un plus

• Hands-on mindset, curioso, con forti capacità analitiche e attenzione ai dettagli.

• Confortevole con la registrazione dei dati/analisi e disposto a contribuire alla configurazione di prova, esecuzione e reporting.

• Forte pensiero logico e capacità di problem solving

• Buone capacità di comunicazione e di lavoro di squadra

descriptionByLocale.en:
If you are looking for an opportunity to dive into hardware and software testing and get hands-on experience in real-world verification challenges, this opportunity is for you.

As an intern, you will co-develop a testing platform designed to validate both software and hardware specifications at a system level, covering functional behavior, power management, and electro-mechanical testing.

Your focus will be on building and maintaining test infrastructure for charging solutions, developing automated test scripts, and running experiments to assess charging behavior in realistic hearing instrument usage scenarios. You will turn raw measurement data into clear reports and actionable insights.

Your work will span the full testing lifecycle, and you will be part of a cross-functional engineering team, giving you direct exposure to real day-to-day challenges in electronics, firmware, and system-level performance — all within the context of innovative hearing device technology.

More about the role

• Establish, calibrate, maintain test infrastructure for charging solutions verification

• Develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts/frameworks to execute verification plans

• Develop test cases for new developed functionalities and adapt existing test cases to new product variations

• Run experiments to assess charging behavior and safety mechanisms in realistic hearing instrument usage scenarios

• Collaborate with engineering teams on requirements and test strategies

• Collect, analyze, and visualize measurement data, prepare clear reports and documentation of test procedures and results.

• Support and troubleshoot measurement setups and contribute to continuous improvement of test workflows.

• Collaborate with engineers on electronics, firmware, integration with the hearing devices, and system-level performance investigations.

More about you

• BSc or MSc in Electrical Engineering or related field

• Basic programming knowledge (Python, MATLAB, C)

• Knowhow in manual and automated hardware testing and troubleshooting of electronic devices is a plus

• Hands-on mindset, curious, with strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

• Comfortable with data logging/analysis and willing to contribute to test setup, execution, and reporting.

• Strong logical thinking and problem-solving skills

• Good communication and teamwork skills

More about what we offer

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model.

We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Sonova, we create innovative hearing solutions that improve the lives of millions of people worldwide. To strengthen our commitment to delivering exceptional product quality and customer experience, we are looking for a Director Reliability Engineering to lead our reliability strategy, build organizational capability, and drive reliability excellence across the full product lifecycle.

In this highly visible leadership role, you will combine people leadership, technical problem-solving, and strategic product reliability planning. You will lead a team of reliability engineers, partner with stakeholders across R&D, Quality, Operations and Product Management, and ensure reliability is embedded into both current products and future innovations.

More about the role

• Lead, develop, and structure a high-performing Reliability Engineering team, establishing effective operating models, governance, and best practices.

• Drive complex product reliability investigations, root cause analyses, and failure assessments of field returns and customer complaints, translating findings into actionable improvement plans.

• Partner with key customers and internal stakeholders to communicate technical findings, present recommendations, and feed reliability learnings back into product development.

• Define and execute Sonova’s reliability engineering strategy, ensuring Design for Reliability principles, methods, and decision-making are embedded from concept through design, verification, industrialization, and lifecycle management.

• Establish and continuously improve reliability methodologies, including D-FMEA, Critical-to-Quality frameworks, reliability planning & accelerated life testing, and data-driven failure analysis.

• Identify reliability risks and opportunities within the innovation pipeline, proactively assessing future products and technologies before market launch.

• Lead cross-functional improvement initiatives that enhance product robustness, customer satisfaction, and long-term business performance.

• Foster a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and reliability excellence across the organization.

More about you

• Degree in Engineering, Physics, Electronics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field.

• 5+ years of leadership experience in Product Reliability Engineering, Reliability Testing, Quality Engineering, or a closely related field.

• Proven track record of leading and developing engineering teams, establishing structures, processes, and ways of working that enable scalability and performance.

• Strong expertise in root cause analysis, design for reliability, failure investigation, and product improvement methodologies.

• Experience working in highly regulated and quality-driven industries such as medical devices, automotive, aerospace, industrial electronics, or similar.

• Ability to influence senior stakeholders and communicate complex technical topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Strategic mindset with the ability to balance operational execution, customer-facing activities, and long-term product reliability planning.

• Fluent English communication skills.

• Knowledge of medical device regulations is advantageous.

More about what we offer:

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

Application process

descriptionByLocale.en:
As Senior Manager Sound Quality Engineering , you will lead a team responsible for evaluating and optimizing the sound quality and performance of Sonova's hearing solutions.

Working closely with experts across Signal Processing, Audiology, Software Engineering, Verification, and other R&D functions, you will ensure that innovative technologies translate into measurable end-user benefit and excellent hearing experiences.

You will guide your team throughout the development process, balancing technical excellence, product quality, timelines and customer value while translating strategic direction into successful execution.

More about the role

• Lead and develop a team of sound quality engineers, creating an environment that fosters collaboration, ownership and continuous development.

• Lead the sound quality engineering activities for Sonova's hearing solutions, ensuring excellent end-user benefit and outstanding hearing experiences.

• Collaborate closely with stakeholders across Signal Processing, Audiology, Software Engineering, Verification and other R&D disciplines.

• Balance innovation, product quality, technical feasibility, timelines and resources throughout the development process.

More about you

Must-have

• Demonstrated leadership experience, for example by leading projects, technical workstreams or serving as a (deputy) team lead.

• Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and managing a broad range of technical stakeholders.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate strategic direction into practical execution.

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to build trust across multidisciplinary teams.

• Professional working proficiency in English.

Nice to have

• Experience within the medical device industry.

• Experience in hearing technology or audiology-related products.

• Familiarity with regulated development environments.

More about what we offer

At Sonova, you'll join a purpose-driven company where your work directly improves people's quality of life.

We offer an international and collaborative working environment in which you'll have the opportunity to lead talented engineers, contribute to innovative hearing technologies and continuously grow both professionally and personally.

In addition, you'll benefit from:

• Flexible hybrid working.

• Individual learning and development opportunities.

• Clear career development paths.

• Modern working environment and collaborative culture.

• Competitive compensation and benefits.

• The opportunity to work on technologies that positively impact millions of people worldwide.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Sonova R&D, we develop deep learning algorithms that help people pick out the sounds they want to hear, like speech in a noisy room. The challenge: these models have to run in real time on our power-constrained hearing devices used by millions of people.

Are you curious to explore these uncharted territories?

Are you an engineer who enjoys adapting and optimizing models to meet latency, memory, and power constraints?

Do you want to contribute to technology where every improvement has a direct impact on how people hear and interact with their environment?

If that speaks to you, we are looking for you, as our new colleague and deep learning engineer.

• Contribute building our DNN training and development software toolchain

• Taking end-to-end ownership of deep learning projects from idea to product deliverable and provide guidance in technical discussions and code reviews

More about you

• Master’s or PhD degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or related technical discipline

• 2+ years of experience in deep learning

• Strong proficiency in Python and fluent in advanced TensorFlow/Keras or PyTorch concepts

• Hands-on experience at the boundary between deep learning and embedded systems

• Communication skills with full professional proficiency in English

• Education in audio or speech processing, and understanding of edge computing/low-power computation and embedded systems is a plus

More about what we offer:

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Sonova, we create innovative hearing care solutions that improve the quality of life for millions of people worldwide. As a Hardware Verification Specialist, you will help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of our hearing aids and accessories before they reach customers.

Working in a collaborative R&D environment, you will combine hands-on technical work with problem-solving and testing, contributing directly to products that make a meaningful difference in people's lives.

More about the role

In this role, you will:

• Execute hardware verification tests on hearing aids, accessories, and assemblies

• Perform acoustic, electronic, mechanical, and chemical measurements using specialized laboratory equipment

• Analyze test results and document findings in technical reports

• Support the development and improvement of test methods, verification processes, and laboratory structures

• Investigate unusual test behaviors and collaborate with engineers to identify root causes

• Maintain laboratory equipment and support day-to-day lab operations

• Contribute to R&D activities, team collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives

More about you

You are a hands-on and detail-oriented professional who enjoys understanding how electronic products work and finding reliable ways to verify their performance. You combine technical curiosity with a structured and quality-focused approach to your work.

Must-Have

• Technical education in Electronics, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

• Hands-on experience with manufacturing, repair, servicing, or troubleshooting electronic devices

• Practical experience with soldering and working with small electronic or electromechanical components

• Strong knowledge of electronics and measurement technologies

• Good English and German communication skills (written and spoken)

• Proactive, quality-focused, and eager to learn

Nice to have

• Experience in hardware verification, testing, or validation

• Experience in medical devices or other regulated industries

• Knowledge of acoustic measurements

• Experience in results documentation

• Familiarity with Confluence and MS Teams

More about what we offer

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, is looking forward to receiving your application (cover letter, CV, references and certificates) via our online job application platform.

For this vacancy only direct applications will be considered.
