• 5 ans et plus d'expérience en gestion de projets de développement de produits complexes et interfonctionnels.
• Expérience éprouvée de direction, de coaching et de développement des gestionnaires de projets ou des équipes techniques.
• Connaissance approfondie du développement multidisciplinaire de produits, y compris du matériel, des logiciels intégrés et des applications logicielles.

title: Patent Engineer (80%-100%) (m/f/d)

descriptionByLocale.it:
In this role, you will become a key partner to inventors, technical experts, patent attorneys and internal stakeholders and an important member of the Patent and Design Rights Team located at the headquarters in Staefa, Switzerland. You will actively contribute to shaping and protecting inventions in the field of hearing devices by supporting the full lifecycle of intellectual property activities. You will coordinate and help drive a variety of IP-related processes, ensuring that ideas are captured, evaluated, and transformed into strong patent and design protections. Working closely with inventors, you will play an essential role in turning innovation into valuable IP assets. In this role you will:
• Support inventors and patent attorneys from initial ideas generation and invention disclosures preparation through patent prosecution and into maintenance and enforcement decisions
• Review patent publications of in the field of hearing systems and prepare IP landscapes
• Provide IP training to inventors, technical patent experts and business partners
• Assist with administrative, organizational and accounting tasks for the Patent and Design Rights Team More about you:
• Degree in electrical engineering, physics, or equivalent work experience and a background in at least one of the following technical fields: wireless communication, signal processing and neural networks
• Corporate experience in international patent practice or project management
• Strong ability to extract and communicate technical and legal concepts clearly and concisely
• Ability to identify, review, and explain patent-related matters and provide IP advice to internal stakeholders Experience in searching and retrieving information from IP databases and registers
• Excellent written and spoken English and German language skills More about what we offer As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we are committed to building an inclusive culture where you can balance a successful career with your life outside of work through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both professional and personal development, with strong growth opportunities supported by individual development plans. Application process Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, is looking forward to receiving your application via our online job application platform, including your CV and cover letter. For this vacancy, only direct applications will be considered. <div dir="auto" style=" width:calc(100% - 16px) !important;"

descriptionByLocale.it:
Condurre lo sviluppo di soluzioni acustiche innovative dal concept al mercato A Sonova, sviluppiamo soluzioni per l'udito innovative che migliorano la qualità della vita per milioni di persone in tutto il mondo. Come Senior Project Manager, guiderai progetti R&D complessi e multidisciplinari attraverso dispositivi acustici, applicazioni software e relativi accessori. Lavorando all'intersezione dell'ingegneria, del software incorporato e dell'innovazione di prodotto, guiderete i progetti dal concept attraverso la consegna di prodotti di successo, garantendo l'allineamento su portata, qualità, tempi e budget, aiutando a portare al mercato le soluzioni uditive di nuova generazione. Ulteriori informazioni sul ruolo
• Leader team di progetto R&D multidisciplinari, guidando lo sviluppo e la consegna di dispositivi acustici innovativi, applicazioni software e accessori.
• Campo di applicazione del proprio progetto, linee temporali, bilancio, risorse e rischi, garantendo la consegna di successo attraverso una pianificazione efficace, la governance e l'esecuzione di stage-gate.
• Costruire partnership forti tra ingegneria, sviluppo del software e altre funzioni aziendali, gestione delle parti interessate, dipendenze cross-project e decisioni chiave del progetto.
• Preparare e presentare gli aggiornamenti del progetto ai comitati di guida, assicurando trasparenza, governance efficace e decisionale informato.
• Sviluppare e mantenere piani di progetto e documentazione in linea con gli standard di gestione del progetto di Sonova e i processi di gestione del portafoglio.
• Valutazioni della tecnologia di azionamento, pianificazione dell'affidabilità e prontezza del progetto, sostenendo le attività di innovazione durante il ciclo di vita di sviluppo del prodotto.
• Identificare, valutare e gestire proattivamente i rischi, i vincoli e le dipendenze del progetto per consentire risultati di successo.
• Promuovere una cultura di team collaborativa e di alto livello focalizzata sulla qualità, l'innovazione e il miglioramento continuo. Più di te Devo
• Laurea o Master in Ingegneria o un'altra disciplina tecnica rilevante.
• 5+ anni di esperienza nell'ingegneria o nello sviluppo del prodotto, idealmente all'interno dell'industria del dispositivo medico o in un altro ambiente altamente regolamentato.
• 3+ anni di esperienza leader complessi, progetti di sviluppo di prodotti multidisciplinari dal concetto alla consegna.
• Forte competenza di gestione del progetto, tra cui pianificazione, gestione delle parti interessate, gestione del rischio, bilancio e governance del progetto.
• Prove capacità di guidare team interfunzionali, navigare complessità e guidare il processo decisionale informato in un ambiente globale.
• Ottima comunicazione, facilitazione e capacità di problem solving con la capacità di influenzare i diversi stakeholder.
• Competenze fluenti in inglese. Che bello avere
• Certificazione Project Management (PMP o equivalente).
• Esperienza all'interno dell'industria dell'udito o del dispositivo medico.
• Esperienza con Planisware, Jira, Confluence o SAP. Lead the development of innovative hearing solutions from concept to market At Sonova, we develop innovative hearing care solutions that improve the quality of life for millions of people worldwide. As a Senior Project Manager, you will lead complex, multidisciplinary R&D projects across hearing devices, software applications and related accessories. Working at the intersection of engineering, embedded software and product innovation, you will drive projects from concept through successful product delivery, ensuring alignment on scope, quality, timelines and budget while helping bring the next generation of hearing solutions to market. • Lead multidisciplinary R&D project teams, driving the successful development and delivery of innovative hearing devices, software applications and accessories.

• Prepare and present project updates to steering committees, ensuring transparency, effective governance and informed decision-making.
• Develop and maintain project plans and documentation in line with Sonova's project management standards and portfolio management processes.
• Drive technology assessments, reliability planning and project readiness while supporting innovation activities throughout the product development lifecycle.

• Foster a collaborative, high-performing team culture focused on quality, innovation and continuous improvement. More about you Must have
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering or another relevant technical discipline.
• 5+ years of experience in engineering or product development, ideally within the medical device industry or another highly regulated environment.
• 3+ years of experience leading complex, multidisciplinary product development projects from concept to delivery.
• Strong project management expertise, including planning, stakeholder management, risk management, budgeting and project governance.
• Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, navigate complexity and drive informed decision-making in a global environment.
• Excellent communication, facilitation and problem-solving skills with the ability to influence diverse stakeholders.
• Fluent English skills. Nice to have
• Project Management certification (PMP or equivalent).
• Experience within the hearing care or medical device industry.
• Experience with Planisware, Jira, Confluence or SAP. descriptionByLocale.it:
Shape the technology behind the future of hearing care At Sonova, we develop innovative hearing solutions that improve the quality of life for millions of people around the world. Behind every successful product is a portfolio of technologies and components that enable exceptional performance, reliability, and user experience. To strengthen our R&D organization, we are looking for a Senior Components Manager who combines technical understanding, strategic thinking, and stakeholder management skills. In this role, you will own a portfolio of key components throughout their entire lifecycle and help define the technologies that power Sonova’s future solutions. • Balancing and aligning Marketing, Technology, and Component Development needs to identify the right compromises and priorities
• Ensuring Sonova maintains a competitive component portfolio that supports future solution and product development
• Driving the adoption and reuse of components across multiple products and offerings
• Collaborating closely with Marketing functions, Component Development teams, and Technology & Function organizations to deliver successful component solutions
• Acting as the central point of ownership and coordination for assigned components across the organization More about you

• Several years of experience in engineering, R&D, or technical product development, combined with exposure to product management, product marketing, technology strategy, or customer/market-driven requirement definition
• Experience in medical devices, hearing technology, consumer electronics, telecommunications, automotive, or other highly regulated industries
• Experience working in cross-functional product development environments
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
• Energy, curiosity, and a strong sense of ownership. Proactively driving topics forward, embracing challenges, and taking accountability for achieving results, even when solutions require balancing competing priorities and navigating uncertainty.
• The ability to balance technical possibilities with customer and business needs

title: Director R&D Process Excellence

descriptionByLocale.it:
We are looking for a strategic and influential leader to join our global R&D organization as Director Group R&D Process Excellence . In this role, you will define and drive the vision for process excellence across our international R&D network, enabling teams to innovate faster, collaborate more effectively, and deliver high-quality solutions in a scalable and compliant way. You will work at the intersection of engineering, portfolio management, quality, regulatory affairs, and operations, helping to build an environment where continuous improvement is embedded into everyday decision-making. What you'll do
• Develop and execute the global strategy and roadmap for R&D process excellence across multiple sites.
• Establish governance, standards, and best practices that create consistency while enabling local flexibility where appropriate.
• Lead the portfolio of process improvement initiatives, ensuring investments are aligned with business priorities and deliver measurable value.
• Coach and advise senior R&D leaders on process performance, continuous improvement, and organizational effectiveness.
• Define and monitor key performance indicators, using data and insights to identify opportunities and guide strategic decisions.
• Facilitate cross-functional collaboration with Quality, Regulatory, PMO, IT, and Operations to optimize end-to-end product development processes.
• Champion methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, and Stage-Gate to build sustainable process excellence capabilities across the organization.
• Ensure R&D processes support compliance, audit readiness, technology transfer, scalability, and future business growth.
• Foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement while leveraging modern technologies, including AI-enabled ways of working. What you bring
• Master's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.
• Significant leadership experience in process excellence, business transformation, or operational improvement within an engineering or R&D environment.
• Proven ability to design, implement, and optimize complex cross-functional processes at a global level.
• Experience leading change initiatives and influencing senior stakeholders across multiple functions and locations.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to define meaningful KPIs and translate data into actionable improvements.
• Excellent facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
• Hands-on experience with continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or similar frameworks.
• Fluency in English. Nice to have
• Experience in the medical technology or other highly regulated industries.
• Additional education in business administration or project management.
• Familiarity with enterprise project portfolio management and SAP-based environments.
• Experience applying AI tools to improve productivity and business processes. Why join us? This is a unique opportunity to influence how a global R&D organization operates and innovates. You'll partner with senior leaders, shape strategic initiatives, and create lasting impact by building processes that enable teams to deliver breakthrough technologies more efficiently and effectively. If you're passionate about continuous improvement, enjoy solving complex organizational challenges, and thrive in collaborative international environments, we'd love to hear from you. <div dir="auto" style=" width:calc(100% - 16px) !important;"

title: Data Architect (m/f/d)

descriptionByLocale.it:
The role As a Data Architect, you will take ownership of how data is structured, connected, and leveraged across our hearing systems. The focus of this role is on data modeling and data design , not on building data platforms. You will define scalable data models across sensor-based devices and software systems, ensuring that data is reliable, compliant, and ready for advanced analytics and AI use cases. In addition, you will act as a technical leader, guiding teams and stakeholders without formal line management responsibility. More about the role
• Define and own the end-to-end data model across connected sensor-based products and software systems
• Design scalable data structures to enable advanced analytics and AI-driven use cases
• Ensure data quality, consistency, traceability and testability across the full data lifecycle
• Provide technical leadership and act as a key point of reference for data modeling and architecture topics
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align data design with product, regulatory, legal and business requirements More about you
• MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science or a related field
• Background in highly data-driven environments such as banking, finance, insurance or healthcare
• Extensive experience in data modeling and data architecture
• Proven experience designing data models for complex systems, ideally in IoT, sensor or connected device environments
• Strong understanding of data governance, data quality and regulatory requirements (e.g. GDPR, medical devices)
• Ability to lead and influence teams and stakeholders without formal disciplinary responsibility
• Strong communication skills with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives
• Passion for data-driven innovation and enabling advanced analytics and AI More about what we offer As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans. <div dir="auto" style=" width:calc(100% - 16px) !important;"

title: Requirements Engineer

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Sonova, we develop innovative hearing solutions that improve the quality of life for millions of people around the world. To help us create products that are both impactful and reliable, we are looking for a Requirements Engineer who enjoys bringing clarity to complexity and collaborating across diverse teams. In this role, you will act as a key link between engineering, quality, verification, and business stakeholders, ensuring that product requirements are clearly defined, understood, and translated into successful solutions. More about the role
• Define, analyze, and maintain product requirements for innovative hearing solutions
• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to align on product features, functionality, and expectations
• Create and maintain clear, structured, and testable requirements and specifications
• Ensure requirements comply with internal processes, quality standards, and applicable regulations
• Maintain traceability between user needs, product requirements, test cases, and risks
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of requirements engineering practices, processes, and tools
• Participate in project development teams and support the successful delivery of new product features More about you
• Engineering degree or equivalent technical education
• Further education or training in Requirements Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related field
• 2+ years of experience in product development, ideally in a Requirements Engineering or similar role
• Experience defining, documenting, and managing requirements throughout the product development lifecycle
• Understanding of hardware and/or software development processes
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, ensuring collaboration within cross-functional teams
• Adaptable, collaborative, proactive, and a strong team player
• Fluent English skills, both written and spoken Nice to have
• IREB Foundation Level, INCOSE, or similar certification
• Experience in regulated industries and/or medical device development
• Familiarity with tools such as Polarion, Jira, Confluence, and MS Teams
• German language skills More about what we offer As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we are committed to building an inclusive culture where you can balance a successful career with your life outside of work through our flexible hybrid working model. For this vacancy, only direct applications will be considered. <div dir="auto" style=" width:calc(100% - 16px) !important;"

title: Data Architect (m/f/d)

descriptionByLocale.it:
The role As a Data Architect, you will take ownership of how data is structured, connected, and leveraged across our hearing systems. The focus of this role is on data modeling and data design , not on building data platforms. You will define scalable data models across sensor-based devices and software systems, ensuring that data is reliable, compliant, and ready for advanced analytics and AI use cases. In addition, you will act as a technical leader, guiding teams and stakeholders without formal line management responsibility. More about the role
• Define and own the end-to-end data model across connected sensor-based products and software systems
• Design scalable data structures to enable advanced analytics and AI-driven use cases
• Ensure data quality, consistency, traceability and testability across the full data lifecycle
• Provide technical leadership and act as a key point of reference for data modeling and architecture topics
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align data design with product, regulatory, legal and business requirements More about you
• MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science or a related field
• Background in highly data-driven environments such as banking, finance, insurance or healthcare
• Extensive experience in data modeling and data architecture
• Proven experience designing data models for complex systems, ideally in IoT, sensor or connected device environments
• Strong understanding of data governance, data quality and regulatory requirements (e.g. GDPR, medical devices)
• Ability to lead and influence teams and stakeholders without formal disciplinary responsibility
• Strong communication skills with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives
• Passion for data-driven innovation and enabling advanced analytics and AI More about what we offer As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans. <div dir="auto" style=" width:calc(100% - 16px) !important;"

descriptionByLocale.it:
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams im Bereich Werkzeugbau / Montage WZB suchen wir einen erfahrenen und engagierten Werkzeugmacher mit Schwerpunkt Spritzgusswerkzeuge . Deine Aufgaben
• Termingerechte Herstellung und Montage von Neuwerkzeugen
• Durchführung von Änderungen, Reparaturen und Servicearbeiten an Spritzgusswerkzeugen
• Ausführung von Unterhalts- und Wartungsarbeiten an Spritzgusswerkzeugen
• Koordination und Bearbeitung der zugewiesenen Aufträge (Neuwerkzeuge, Änderungen, Reparaturen, Service) gemäss Prioritäten
• Sicherstellung eines vollständigen und qualitativ korrekten Auftragsabschlusses in Zusammenarbeit mit Equipment & Tool Design (ETD) und Molding
• Analyse von Mängeln und Qualitätsproblemen sowie Erarbeitung und Vorschlag geeigneter Massnahmen
• Fachtechnische Mitarbeit in Optimierungs- und Innovationsprojekten Dein Profil
• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Werkzeugmacher oder Polymechaniker, Fachrichtung Formenbau
• Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Werkzeugbau
• Erfahrung im Umgang mit Spritzgusswerkzeugen
• Sicherer Umgang mit technischen Unterlagen und Arbeitsaufträgen
• Sehr exakte und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
• Hohe Zuverlässigkeit und Selbstständigkeit
• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Unser Angebot Als einer der weltweit führenden Hörakustik-Anbieter mit Hauptsitz in der Schweiz setzen wir uns für eine inklusive Unternehmenskultur ein. title: Director Customer Support

descriptionByLocale.it:
About Sonova Sonova is a global leader in innovative hearing care solutions: from personal audio devices and wireless communication systems to audiological care services, hearing aids and cochlear implants. Sonova operates through 3 businesses - Hearing Instruments (Wholesale + Retail), Consumer Hearing and Cochlear Implants – and the core brands Phonak, Unitron, AudioNova, Sennheiser (under license) and Advanced Bionics as well as recognized regional brands. The Group’s globally diversified sales and distribution channels serve an ever-growing consumer base in more than 100 countries. In financial year 2024/205, Sonova Group achieved consolidated sales of over CHF 3.8 billion with adjusted EBITA of CHF 807.8 million. About the role The Director Customer Support is globally responsible for designing, standardizing, and continuously improving the customer service framework. Acting as Global Process Owner, this role defines the support models, structures, and governance that enable regions and countries to deliver accessible, predictable, and customer-friendly service. By balancing global consistency with local flexibility, the Director ensures customer service is scalable, efficient, and positioned as a differentiator for Sonova. This role champions service excellence and empowers customer-facing teams worldwide to deliver seamless experiences that increase satisfaction, loyalty, and efficiency. Key responsibilities: Global Process Ownership & Governance
• Define and govern global customer service processes, including escalation models, response standards, and knowledge management frameworks.
• Build global SOPs, playbooks, and standard work to ensure consistent service across all markets.
• Act as Global Process Owner, accountable for end-to-end customer service delivery and performance across regions. Support Model Design & Optimization
• Design and optimize support structures (e.g., tiered models, remote vs. field service, multilingual capabilities) to balance scale, cost, and customer satisfaction.
• Partner with local and regional leaders to adapt models for market-specific needs while protecting global standards.
• Ensure support models are scalable and flexible to address future growth and changing customer expectations. Service Excellence & Culture
• Drive a customer-centric service culture, embedding excellence into daily operations through training, coaching, and performance management.
• Provide global playbooks, best practices, and frameworks that enable customer-facing roles to deliver consistently high-quality service.
• Act as role model and champion for customer-first mindset across service teams worldwide. Performance & KPI Framework
• Establish, track, and govern global KPIs for customer service (e.g., First-Time Resolution, Time to Respond, Service Satisfaction, Complaint Resolution).
• Provide transparent reporting and dashboards that support global oversight and local accountability.
• Partner with local leaders to analyze results, identify performance gaps, and implement improvement actions. Scalability & Infrastructure
• Build scalable capabilities for customer service delivery, ensuring systems, tools, and processes are aligned across markets.
• Partner with IT and Digital to deploy knowledge management platforms, automation, and AI-powered solutions that reduce manual work and improve responsiveness.
• Continuously enhance efficiency and cost-effectiveness while safeguarding service quality. About you
• University degree in business administration, project management, marketing, communications or related field.
• 8–10 years in customer service leadership with global or multi-market scope.
• Exceptional customer-orientation and a strong background in support model design and optimization, balancing global consistency with local flexibility.
• Demonstrable experience in leading and designing customer support / service strategies and integrating new solutions (digital, AI) to automate and enhance service.
• Strategically thinker with strong analytical/problem-solving skills.
• Entrepreneurial mindset, including a high tolerance for ambiguity and penchant for experimentation.
• Pronounced hands-on mentality and bias towards action.
• Strong continuous improvement mindset and capability to develop and improve processes whilst juggling competing project timelines.
• Ability to effect change, leading people, process, and technology in a dynamic and complex operating environment.
• A proactive collaborator who enjoys working across functions and leading others indirectly within a matrixial organization.
• Strong stakeholder management with a proven ability to influence leadership up to CxO level. <div dir="auto" style=" width:calc(100% - 16px) !important;"

title: Produktionsmitarbeiter Elektronikfertigung (SMT / AOI)

descriptionByLocale.it:
In dieser Rolle sind Sie ein wichtiger Teil unserer Elektronik- und Hörgerätefertigung. Mit Ihrem technischen Verständnis, Ihrer Präzision und Ihrem Qualitätsbewusstsein leisten Sie einen entscheidenden Beitrag zur Herstellung hochwertiger Hörlösungen. Im Gegenzug bieten wir Ihnen ein stabiles Produktionsumfeld, moderne Technologien und vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen Weiterentwicklung. !Bitte beachten Sie, dass im Rahmen unseres internationalen Recruiting-Setups die zuständige Recruiterin bzw. der zuständige Recruiter aus Deutschland oder Polen Kontakt mit Ihnen aufnehmen kann. Wir bitten Sie, dies bei eingehenden Anrufen oder E-Mails im Bewerbungsprozess zu berücksichtigen.! More about the role
• Bedienung der Anlagen Surface Mount Technology (SMT)
• Bedienung und Absicherung der Automated Optical Inspection (AOI)
• Visuelle Kontrolle / Prüfung der Elektronik unter dem Mikroskop
• Analyse von Störungen und erste Maßnahmen zur Behebung in enger Zusammenarbeit mit technischen Schnittstellen und Führungskräften
• Sicherstellung eines klaren Informationsflusses zur Führungskräften
• Dokumentation von Aufträgen sowie korrekte Erfassung von Arbeits- und Auftragszeiten
• Aktive Mitarbeit an Shopfloor-Aktivitäten und kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozessen
• Unterstützung anderer Abteilungen bei Bedarf sowie Einhaltung von Qualitäts-, Sicherheits- und Arbeitsvorgaben More about you
• Abgeschlossene Schulbildung (Sekundarstufe II), idealerweise mit technischem Hintergrund;
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in SMT / AOI Umfeld , zum Beispiel Zertifikat SMD Bestückung, Zertifikat AOI Bedienung
• Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Produktionsumfeld, vorzugsweise an SMT-Linien und in der AOI-Bedienung
• Erfahrung in der Elektronik- oder Medizintechnik von Vorteil
• Sehr gutes Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsbewusstsein, Zertifikat ICP von Vorteil
• Strukturierte, zuverlässige und flexible Arbeitsweise
• Teamfähigkeit, Lernbereitschaft und Offenheit für Veränderungen
• Deutschkenntnisse mindestens auf Niveau B1, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil
• Grundkenntnisse im Umgang mit PC-Systemen, idealerweise Erfahrung mit SAP
• Konventionelles Löten, Lackieren und Montieren von Bauteilen von Vorteil More about what we offer Als eines der weltweit führenden Unternehmen im Bereich Hörlösungen mit Hauptsitz in der Schweiz legen wir großen Wert auf eine inklusive und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur. Wir bieten dir:
• Flexible Anstellungsmöglichkeiten (80–100 %)
• Strukturierte Einarbeitung sowie gezielte interne und externe Weiterbildungen
• Individuelle Entwicklungs- und Wachstumsmöglichkeiten
• Ein modernes Produktionsumfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen
• Die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Prozesse aktiv mitzugestalten <div dir="auto" style=" width:calc(100% - 16px) !important;"

descriptionByLocale.it:
Wir suchen für unser HR Team eine(n) erfahrene(n) Payroll Specialist , der/die die operative Lohnverarbeitung für den Standort Schweiz betreut – in engem Austausch mit unserem internationalen Umfeld und dem Shared Service Center (SSC) in Warschau. Dies ist eine unbefristete Teilzeitstelle mit einem Pensum von 80%. Aufgaben
• Übermittlung der Quellensteuer via ELM-Schnittstelle sowie Abstimmung und Klärung von Differenzen
• Verantwortung für das Absenzmanagement bei Unfall und Krankheit inkl. Taggeldverarbeitung
• Gesamte Abwicklung des Familienzulagenprozesses
• Verarbeitung von Arbeitgeberbescheinigungen und Zwischenverdiensten
• Bearbeitung der AHV-Akontorechnungen
• Beratung von Mitarbeitenden, Führungskräften und HR-Kolleg*innen zur Lohnabrechnung, Bearbeitung von Mitarbeitendenanfragen über AskHR
• Unterstützung bei Jahresendarbeiten Anforderungen
• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Schweizer Payroll
• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Sozialversicherungen und Einkommensteuer/Quellensteuer
• Sicherer Umgang mit SAP, Erfahrung mit ELM-Schnittstelle
• Erfahrung in internationalen Unternehmen (1000+ MA)
• Hohe Genauigkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und analytisches Denken
• Vertrauenswürdigkeit und absolute Diskretion
• Ausbildung als HR‑Assistent*in oder kaufmännische Grundausbildung (von Vorteil)
• Fliessendes Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch (ca. 50/50) Wir bieten Als eines der weltweit führenden Unternehmen im Bereich Hörlösungen mit Hauptsitz in der Schweiz legen wir großen Wert auf eine inklusive und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur.
• Kollegiales, offenes und unterstützendes Team

• Zusammenarbeit mit vielfältigen internen und externen Stakeholdern

title: Requirements Engineer

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Sonova, we develop innovative hearing solutions that improve the quality of life for millions of people around the world. To help us create products that are both impactful and reliable, we are looking for a Requirements Engineer who enjoys bringing clarity to complexity and collaborating across diverse teams. In this role, you will act as a key link between engineering, quality, verification, and business stakeholders, ensuring that product requirements are clearly defined, understood, and translated into successful solutions. More about the role
• Define, analyze, and maintain product requirements for innovative hearing solutions
• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to align on product features, functionality, and expectations
• Create and maintain clear, structured, and testable requirements and specifications
• Ensure requirements comply with internal processes, quality standards, and applicable regulations
• Maintain traceability between user needs, product requirements, test cases, and risks
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of requirements engineering practices, processes, and tools
• Participate in project development teams and support the successful delivery of new product features More about you
• Engineering degree or equivalent technical education
• Further education or training in Requirements Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related field
• 2+ years of experience in product development, ideally in a Requirements Engineering or similar role
• Experience defining, documenting, and managing requirements throughout the product development lifecycle
• Understanding of hardware and/or software development processes
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, ensuring collaboration within cross-functional teams
• Adaptable, collaborative, proactive, and a strong team player
• Fluent English skills, both written and spoken Nice to have
• IREB Foundation Level, INCOSE, or similar certification
• Experience in regulated industries and/or medical device development
• Familiarity with tools such as Polarion, Jira, Confluence, and MS Teams
• German language skills More about what we offer As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we are committed to building an inclusive culture where you can balance a successful career with your life outside of work through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both professional and personal development, with strong growth opportunities supported by individual development plans. Application process Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, is looking forward to receiving your application via our online job application platform, including your CV, design portfolio, and cover letter. For this vacancy, only direct applications will be considered. <div dir="auto" style=" width:calc(100% - 16px) !important;"

sector: MedTech / Hearing care (hearing aids, cochlear implants, consumer hearing)

title: Incoming Inspection Specialist (m/f/d)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione In un mondo senza suono, il nostro lavoro acquista un senso. Come parte della nostra organizzazione, garantiamo la qualità e la conformità dei materiali consegnati e supportiamo i processi di produzione. Insieme, creiamo soluzioni che migliorano i nostri processi e garantiscono la qualità dei nostri prodotti. Aiutaci ora a mantenere i nostri elevati standard di qualità. Mansioni - Disimballaggio e preparazione professionale dei materiali consegnati per la lavorazione e i controlli di qualità - Avvio e documentazione di serie speciali per l'approvazione di materiali o lotti - Esecuzione del processo ISIR (Initial Sample Inspection Report) compresa la documentazione associata - Controlli di qualità secondo le specifiche e monitoraggio del rispetto delle norme interne - Garanzia della gestione professionale di materiali non conformi (blocco, etichettatura) - Reimballaggio e etichettatura dei materiali consegnati con dimensioni di imballaggio diverse - Supporto attraverso l'utilizzo e la gestione del tavolo MODI e creazione di ticket SNOW, gestione NC e segnalazioni Q in SAP
• Requisiti - Formazione di base in un campo tecnico o relativo alla qualità o esperienza professionale rilevante nel settore MedTech o farmaceutico - Conoscenze avanzate nel campo della qualità e esperienza nella garanzia della qualità (ad es. tecnica di misurazione, specialista in qualità) - Capacità di lavorare in team, affidabilità e apertura, nonché una marcata autocoscienza con focus sul miglioramento continuo - Pensiero orientato alla qualità e alla gestione aziendale - Tedesco parlato e scritto (leggere e comprendere), conoscenze di base dell'inglese - Utilizzo sicuro di MS Office e SAP (WMS/MM) - EFZ o certificati come SAQ ispettore di qualità sono un vantaggio - Flessibile e resiliente, anche in situazioni impegnative e frenetiche
• Cosa offriamo Come uno dei leader mondiali nel campo della salute uditiva con sede in Svizzera, ci impegniamo a costruire una cultura aziendale inclusiva. In questo ruolo, assumi una grande responsabilità e hai l'opportunità di svilupparti continuamente. Lavori su compiti vari e ottieni una visione di diversi settori, rendendo la tua giornata lavorativa varia e interessante. Inoltre, offriamo un'ampia gamma di opportunità di formazione e sviluppo per la tua crescita professionale e personale, nonché eccezionali opportunità di crescita con piani di sviluppo individuali. Contatto Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, è felice di ricevere la tua candidatura completa tramite la nostra piattaforma di candidatura online.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description In a life without sound, our work makes sense. As part of our organization, we ensure the quality and conformity of delivered materials and support production processes. Together, we create solutions that improve our processes and guarantee the quality of our products. Support us now in maintaining our high quality standards.
• Responsibilities - Unpacking and professional preparation of delivered materials for further processing and quality inspections - Initiation and documentation of special series for the approval of materials or batches - Execution of the ISIR process (Initial Sample Inspection Report) including associated documentation - Quality inspections according to specifications and monitoring of compliance with internal regulations - Ensuring the proper handling of non-conforming material (blocking, labeling) - Repackaging and labeling of delivered materials with deviating packaging sizes - Support through operation and maintenance of the MODI table as well as creation of SNOW tickets, NC processing, and Q notifications in SAP
• Requirements - Basic training in a technical or quality-related field or relevant professional experience in the MedTech or pharmaceutical sector - Advanced knowledge in quality management and experience in quality assurance (e.g., measurement technology, quality specialist) - Teamwork, reliability, and openness, as well as pronounced self-reflection with a focus on continuous improvement - Quality-oriented and business-minded thinking - German spoken and written (reading & understanding), basic English skills - Confident handling of MS Office and SAP (WMS/MM) - EFZ or certificates like SAQ quality inspector are an advantage - Flexible and resilient, even in demanding and hectic situations
• What we offer As one of the world's leading companies in the field of hearing health with headquarters in Switzerland, we are committed to building an inclusive corporate culture. In this role, you take on high responsibility and have the opportunity to continuously develop yourself. You work on varied tasks and gain insights into different areas, making your workday diverse and exciting. descriptionByLocale.en:
The Director, Performance Management & Capabilities Building is a strategic leader responsible for defining and executing Sonova’s global learning, performance management, and talent development strategies. This role oversees the design and implementation of the Academies framework, coaching and mentoring programmes—including AI-enabled approaches—graduate development, and scalable learning offerings that build organisational capability at all levels.

Accountable for shaping and embedding a robust performance management framework, this role partners closely with senior leaders to drive goal setting and talent development for Sonova’s Top 200+ leaders, ensuring alignment with business priorities and leadership standards. The Director leads flagship talent development programmes, individual career journey design, and the talent review process, fostering a culture of continuous growth and high performance.

This role ensures integration and alignment of learning and performance initiatives with broader talent functions such as talent acquisition, culture transformation, and Org E&E. The Director also collaborates with HR Strategy to develop and maintain a comprehensive skills architecture and taxonomy that supports Sonova’s evolving capability needs.

In this role, you will:

Lead Learning and Academies

• Define, develop, and oversee the global Academies framework and its implementation to build critical capabilities across Sonova.

• Design and deliver coaching and mentoring programmes, incorporating AI-enabled tools and approaches to enhance learning effectiveness.

• Manage graduate programmes and scalable learning offerings to support talent development at all organisational levels.

Drive Performance Management Framework

• Own and continuously evolve Sonova’s performance management framework, ensuring alignment with organisational goals and leadership expectations.

• Lead goal-setting processes for the Top 200 leaders, fostering accountability and clear performance expectations.

• Partner with HR and business leaders to embed performance management practices that drive high performance and development.

Talent Development and Career Journey Design

• Lead the design and execution of individual career journeys for Sonova’s Top 200 talent, supporting personalised growth and succession planning.

• Oversee flagship talent development programmes, including approach design, assessment methodologies, and delivery.

• Develop and implement people leadership standards and related development programmes to strengthen leadership capabilities across the organisation.

Talent Review and Succession Processes

• Manage the talent review approach and processes, ensuring robust assessment and calibration of talent across business units.

• Collaborate with HR Strategy and Org E&E team to align talent development efforts with organisational capability needs and succession plans.

Skills Architecture and Taxonomy

• Partner with HR Strategy to develop, maintain, and evolve a comprehensive skills architecture and taxonomy that supports workforce planning and capability building.

• Ensure skills frameworks are integrated into learning, performance management, and talent development initiatives.

Stakeholder Engagement and Collaboration

• Work closely with business leaders, HR Business Partners, and the Talent Centre of Excellence to ensure learning and performance strategies are aligned with business priorities.

• Collaborate with external partners, including business schools and learning providers, to enhance programme quality and innovation.

• Manage vendor relationships and oversee quality management systems for external learning and assessment providers.

Innovation and Continuous Improvement

• Champion a culture of continuous learning and development, leveraging digital and multimedia solutions to maximise reach and impact.

• Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness, adoption, and compliance of learning and performance programmes, using data to drive improvements.

• Stay abreast of industry trends and best practices to ensure Sonova remains a leader in leadership development and talent management.

Your Profile:

• 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in global learning, leadership development, and performance management, with a proven track record of designing and scaling high-impact talent development programmes in complex, matrixed organisations.

• Master’s degree in Psychology, Human Resources, Business, or a related field; formal training or qualification in talent development or coaching is highly desirable.

• Ability to develop and execute integrated learning and performance strategies that align with business objectives, drive organisational transformation, and foster a culture of continuous development and high performance.

• Deep knowledge of leadership models, coaching methodologies (including AI-enabled coaching), and talent development frameworks, with experience leading flagship programmes for senior and emerging leaders.

• Strong analytical skills with expertise in leveraging learning analytics, programme evaluation, and performance data to inform strategy, optimise learning experiences, and demonstrate measurable business impact.

• Exceptional stakeholder management and internal consulting skills, with a proven ability to influence senior executives and cross-functional leaders, champion change initiatives, and navigate organisational complexity with agility and resilience.

• Skilled in designing blended learning solutions that incorporate digital, experiential, and social learning modalities at scale, utilising cutting-edge technologies and platforms to enhance engagement and accessibility.

• Experience leading diverse, geographically dispersed teams and programmes across multiple regions (EMEA, Americas, APAC), with sensitivity to cultural nuances and local market dynamics.

• Proven capability in managing budgets, vendor relationships, and quality assurance processes to deliver cost-effective, scalable, and compliant learning and performance management solutions.

• Expertise in learning management systems (e.g., SuccessFactors) and other digital tools that support learning analytics and talent development

• Outstanding communication, presentation, and facilitation skills, capable of engaging and inspiring audiences at all organisational levels, from store sales employees to C-suite executives

• Proven experience designing and implementing diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives within learning and talent development strategies to build inclusive leadership capabilities.

• Experience working within a corporate headquarters environment, collaborating closely with HR Centres of Excellence, business leaders, and external partners such as business schools and learning providers

• English is a must; proficiency in multiple languages is an asset.

More about what we offer

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

For this vacancy, only direct applications will be considered.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il Direttore, Performance Management & Capabilities Building è un leader strategico responsabile della definizione e dell'esecuzione delle strategie globali di apprendimento, gestione delle prestazioni e sviluppo dei talenti di Sonova. Questo ruolo supervisiona la progettazione e l'implementazione della struttura delle Accademie, dei programmi di coaching e mentoring, compresi gli approcci basati sull'intelligenza artificiale, dello sviluppo dei laureati e delle offerte di apprendimento scalabili che sviluppano capacità organizzative a tutti i livelli. Responsabile della definizione e dell'integrazione di un solido quadro di gestione delle prestazioni, questo ruolo collabora strettamente con i leader senior per guidare la definizione degli obiettivi e lo sviluppo dei talenti per gli oltre 200 leader di Sonova, garantendo l'allineamento con le priorità aziendali e gli standard di leadership. Il Direttore guida i principali programmi di sviluppo dei talenti, la progettazione del percorso di carriera individuale e il processo di revisione dei talenti, promuovendo una cultura di crescita continua e prestazioni elevate. Questo ruolo garantisce l'integrazione e l'allineamento delle iniziative di apprendimento e performance con funzioni di talento più ampie come l'acquisizione di talenti, la trasformazione della cultura e l'E&E dell'organizzazione. Il Direttore collabora inoltre con HR Strategy per sviluppare e mantenere un’architettura e una tassonomia complete delle competenze che supporti le esigenze di capacità in evoluzione di Sonova. In questo ruolo: Condurrai la formazione e le Accademie
• Definirai, svilupperai e supervisionerai la struttura globale delle Accademie e la sua implementazione per sviluppare capacità critiche in Sonova.
• Progettare e fornire programmi di coaching e mentoring, incorporando strumenti e approcci abilitati all'intelligenza artificiale per migliorare l'efficacia dell'apprendimento.
• Gestire programmi di laurea e offerte di formazione scalabili per supportare lo sviluppo dei talenti a tutti i livelli organizzativi. Promuovere il quadro di gestione delle prestazioni
• Possedere ed evolvere continuamente il quadro di gestione delle prestazioni di Sonova, garantendo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi organizzativi e le aspettative della leadership.
• Condurre processi di definizione degli obiettivi per i primi 200 leader, promuovendo la responsabilità e chiare aspettative di prestazione.
• Collaborare con i leader aziendali e delle risorse umane per incorporare pratiche di gestione delle prestazioni che promuovono prestazioni elevate e sviluppo. Sviluppo dei talenti e progettazione del percorso di carriera
• Guidare la progettazione e l'esecuzione di percorsi di carriera individuali per i 200 migliori talenti di Sonova, supportando la crescita personalizzata e la pianificazione della successione.
• Supervisionare i principali programmi di sviluppo dei talenti, compresa la progettazione dell'approccio, le metodologie di valutazione e la fornitura.
• Sviluppare e implementare standard di leadership del personale e relativi programmi di sviluppo per rafforzare le capacità di leadership in tutta l'organizzazione. Revisione dei talenti e processi di successione
• Gestire l'approccio e i processi di revisione dei talenti, garantendo una solida valutazione e calibrazione dei talenti tra le unità aziendali.
• Collaborare con il team HR Strategy e Org E&E per allineare gli sforzi di sviluppo dei talenti con le esigenze di capacità organizzative e i piani di successione. Architettura e tassonomia delle competenze
• Collaborare con la strategia HR per sviluppare, mantenere e far evolvere un'architettura e una tassonomia complete delle competenze che supporti la pianificazione della forza lavoro e lo sviluppo delle capacità.
• Garantire che i quadri delle competenze siano integrati nelle iniziative di apprendimento, gestione delle prestazioni e sviluppo dei talenti. Coinvolgimento e collaborazione delle parti interessate
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con i leader aziendali, i partner aziendali delle risorse umane e il Centro di eccellenza per i talenti per garantire che le strategie di apprendimento e performance siano allineate con le priorità aziendali.
• Collaborare con partner esterni, tra cui business school e fornitori di formazione, per migliorare la qualità e l'innovazione del programma.
• Gestire le relazioni con i fornitori e supervisionare i sistemi di gestione della qualità per i fornitori esterni di formazione e valutazione. Innovazione e miglioramento continuo
• Promuovere una cultura di apprendimento e sviluppo continui, sfruttando soluzioni digitali e multimediali per massimizzare la portata e l'impatto.
• Monitorare e valutare l'efficacia, l'adozione e la conformità dei programmi di apprendimento e performance, utilizzando i dati per promuovere miglioramenti.
• Rimanere al passo con le tendenze e le migliori pratiche del settore per garantire che Sonova rimanga leader nello sviluppo della leadership e nella gestione dei talenti. Il tuo profilo:
• Oltre 12 anni di esperienza di leadership progressiva nell'apprendimento globale, nello sviluppo della leadership e nella gestione delle prestazioni, con una comprovata esperienza nella progettazione e implementazione di programmi di sviluppo dei talenti ad alto impatto in organizzazioni complesse e a matrice.
• Laurea magistrale in psicologia, risorse umane, economia o un campo correlato; è altamente auspicabile una formazione formale o una qualifica nello sviluppo dei talenti o nel coaching.
• Capacità di sviluppare ed eseguire strategie integrate di apprendimento e performance in linea con gli obiettivi aziendali, guidare la trasformazione organizzativa e promuovere una cultura di sviluppo continuo e prestazioni elevate.
• Conoscenza approfondita di modelli di leadership, metodologie di coaching (incluso il coaching basato sull'intelligenza artificiale) e strutture di sviluppo dei talenti, con esperienza nella guida di programmi di punta per leader senior ed emergenti.
• Forti capacità analitiche con esperienza nello sfruttamento dell'analisi dell'apprendimento, della valutazione dei programmi e dei dati sulle prestazioni per informare la strategia, ottimizzare le esperienze di apprendimento e dimostrare un impatto aziendale misurabile.
• Eccezionali capacità di gestione delle parti interessate e di consulenza interna, con una comprovata capacità di influenzare dirigenti senior e leader interfunzionali, promuovere iniziative di cambiamento e affrontare la complessità organizzativa con agilità e resilienza.
• Abile nella progettazione di soluzioni di apprendimento misto che incorporano modalità di apprendimento digitale, esperienziale e sociale su larga scala, utilizzando tecnologie e piattaforme all'avanguardia per migliorare il coinvolgimento e l'accessibilità.
• Esperienza nella guida di team e programmi diversificati e geograficamente dispersi in più regioni (EMEA, Americhe, APAC), con sensibilità alle sfumature culturali e alle dinamiche del mercato locale.
• Comprovata capacità di gestire budget, rapporti con i fornitori e processi di garanzia della qualità per fornire soluzioni di formazione e gestione delle prestazioni economicamente vantaggiose, scalabili e conformi.
• Competenza nei sistemi di gestione dell'apprendimento (ad esempio, SuccessFactors) e altri strumenti digitali che supportano l'analisi dell'apprendimento e lo sviluppo dei talenti
• Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione, presentazione e facilitazione, in grado di coinvolgere e ispirare il pubblico a tutti i livelli organizzativi, dai dipendenti delle vendite dei negozi ai dirigenti di alto livello
• Comprovata esperienza nella progettazione e implementazione di iniziative di diversità, equità e inclusione all'interno di strategie di apprendimento e sviluppo del talento per costruire capacità di leadership inclusive.
• Esperienza di lavoro all'interno di un ambiente di sede aziendale, collaborando a stretto contatto con centri di eccellenza delle risorse umane, leader aziendali e partner esterni come business school e fornitori di formazione
• L'inglese è un must; la conoscenza di più lingue costituisce un vantaggio. Diese Rolle überwacht die Gestaltung und Umsetzung des Academies-Rahmens, der Coaching- und Mentoring-Programme – einschließlich KI-gestützter Ansätze –, der Absolventenentwicklung und skalierbarer Lernangebote, die die organisatorischen Fähigkeiten auf allen Ebenen stärken. Diese Rolle ist für die Gestaltung und Einbettung eines robusten Leistungsmanagementrahmens verantwortlich und arbeitet eng mit Führungskräften zusammen, um die Zielsetzung und Talententwicklung für die über 200 Top-Führungskräfte von Sonova voranzutreiben und die Ausrichtung an Geschäftsprioritäten und Führungsstandards sicherzustellen. Der Direktor leitet Flaggschiff-Talententwicklungsprogramme, die Gestaltung individueller Karrierewege und den Talentbewertungsprozess und fördert so eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Wachstums und der hohen Leistung. Diese Rolle gewährleistet die Integration und Abstimmung von Lern- und Leistungsinitiativen mit umfassenderen Talentfunktionen wie Talentakquise, Kulturtransformation und Org E&E. Der Direktor arbeitet auch mit HR Strategy zusammen, um eine umfassende Kompetenzarchitektur und -taxonomie zu entwickeln und aufrechtzuerhalten, die den sich entwickelnden Fähigkeitsbedarf von Sonova unterstützt. In dieser Rolle werden Sie: Learning and Academies leiten
• Das globale Academies-Framework und seine Implementierung definieren, entwickeln und überwachen, um wichtige Fähigkeiten bei Sonova aufzubauen.
• Entwerfen und liefern Sie Coaching- und Mentoring-Programme unter Einbeziehung KI-gestützter Tools und Ansätze zur Verbesserung der Lerneffektivität.
• Verwalten Sie Graduiertenprogramme und skalierbare Lernangebote, um die Talententwicklung auf allen Organisationsebenen zu unterstützen. Fördern Sie das Performance-Management-Framework.
• Besitzen Sie das Performance-Management-Framework von Sonova und entwickeln Sie es kontinuierlich weiter, um die Übereinstimmung mit den Unternehmenszielen und Führungserwartungen sicherzustellen.
• Leiten Sie Zielsetzungsprozesse für die Top-200-Führungskräfte und fördern Sie Verantwortlichkeit und klare Leistungserwartungen.
• Arbeiten Sie mit HR- und Unternehmensleitern zusammen, um Leistungsmanagementpraktiken zu verankern, die eine hohe Leistung und Entwicklung fördern. Talententwicklung und Gestaltung von Karrierewegen
• Leiten Sie die Gestaltung und Durchführung individueller Karrierewege für die Top 200 Talente von Sonova und unterstützen Sie personalisiertes Wachstum und Nachfolgeplanung.
• Beaufsichtigung wichtiger Talententwicklungsprogramme, einschließlich Ansatzdesign, Bewertungsmethoden und Durchführung.
• Entwickeln und implementieren Sie Personalführungsstandards und damit verbundene Entwicklungsprogramme, um die Führungskompetenzen im gesamten Unternehmen zu stärken. Talentüberprüfungs- und Nachfolgeprozesse
• ​​Verwalten Sie den Ansatz und die Prozesse zur Talentüberprüfung und stellen Sie so eine solide Bewertung und Kalibrierung von Talenten in allen Geschäftsbereichen sicher.
• Arbeiten Sie mit dem HR-Strategie- und Org-E&E-Team zusammen, um die Talententwicklungsbemühungen mit den Fähigkeitenanforderungen der Organisation und Nachfolgeplänen in Einklang zu bringen. Kompetenzarchitektur und -taxonomie

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass Kompetenzrahmen in Lern-, Leistungsmanagement- und Talententwicklungsinitiativen integriert werden. Einbindung und Zusammenarbeit von Stakeholdern

• Überwachen und bewerten Sie die Wirksamkeit, Akzeptanz und Compliance von Lern- und Leistungsprogrammen und nutzen Sie Daten, um Verbesserungen voranzutreiben.
• Bleiben Sie über Branchentrends und Best Practices auf dem Laufenden, um sicherzustellen, dass Sonova weiterhin führend in der Führungskräfteentwicklung und im Talentmanagement bleibt. Ihr Profil:

• Fähigkeit, integrierte Lern- und Leistungsstrategien zu entwickeln und umzusetzen, die auf die Geschäftsziele abgestimmt sind, den organisatorischen Wandel vorantreiben und eine Kultur der kontinuierlichen Entwicklung und Höchstleistung fördern.
• Fundierte Kenntnisse über Führungsmodelle, Coaching-Methoden (einschließlich KI-gestütztem Coaching) und Talententwicklungsrahmen, mit Erfahrung in der Leitung von Flaggschiff-Programmen für erfahrene und aufstrebende Führungskräfte.
• Starke analytische Fähigkeiten mit Fachwissen in der Nutzung von Lernanalysen, Programmbewertung und Leistungsdaten, um Strategien zu informieren, Lernerfahrungen zu optimieren und messbare geschäftliche Auswirkungen zu demonstrieren.

descriptionByLocale.en:
In this role, you will become a key partner to inventors, technical experts, patent attorneys and internal stakeholders and an important member of the Patent and Design Rights Team located at the headquarters in Staefa, Switzerland. You will actively contribute to shaping and protecting inventions in the field of hearing devices by supporting the full lifecycle of intellectual property activities.
You will coordinate and help drive a variety of IP-related processes, ensuring that ideas are captured, evaluated, and transformed into strong patent and design protections. Working closely with inventors, you will play an essential role in turning innovation into valuable IP assets.

In this role you will:

• Support inventors and patent attorneys from initial ideas generation and invention disclosures preparation through patent prosecution and into maintenance and enforcement decisions

• Review patent publications of in the field of hearing systems and prepare IP landscapes

• Provide IP training to inventors, technical patent experts and business partners

• Assist with administrative, organizational and accounting tasks for the Patent and Design Rights Team

More about you:

• Degree in electrical engineering, physics, or equivalent work experience and a background in at least one of the following technical fields: wireless communication, signal processing and neural networks

• Corporate experience in international patent practice or project management

• Strong ability to extract and communicate technical and legal concepts clearly and concisely

• Ability to identify, review, and explain patent-related matters and provide IP advice to internal stakeholders Experience in searching and retrieving information from IP databases and registers

• Excellent written and spoken English and German language skills

More about what we offer

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we are committed to building an inclusive culture where you can balance a successful career with your life outside of work through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both professional and personal
development, with strong growth opportunities supported by individual development plans.

Application process

Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, is looking forward to receiving your application via our online job application platform, including your CV and cover letter. For this vacancy, only direct applications will be considered.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In questo ruolo, diventerai un partner chiave per gli inventori, gli esperti tecnici, gli avvocati dei brevetti e i stakeholders interni e un importante membro del Team dei Diritti di Brevetto e Design situato presso la sede centrale a Staefa, Svizzera. Aiuterai attivamente a plasmare e proteggere le invenzioni nel campo dei dispositivi di ascolto supportando l'intero ciclo di attività relative ai diritti intellettuali.

Aiuterai a coordinare e a far progredire una varietà di processi relativi ai diritti di proprietà intellettuale, assicurando che le idee siano catturate, valutate e trasformate in forti protezioni brevettuali e di design. Lavorando in stretta collaborazione con gli inventori, svolgerai un ruolo essenziale per trasformare l'innovazione in valori IP.

In questo ruolo, farai:

• Supporterai gli inventori e gli avvocati dei brevetti dalle fasi di generazione delle idee e della preparazione delle dichiarazioni di invenzione fino alla procura brevettuale e alle decisioni di mantenimento e di esecuzione.

• Valuterai le pubblicazioni brevettuali nel campo dei sistemi di ascolto e preparerai paesaggi IP.

• Fornirai formazione IP agli inventori, agli esperti di brevetti tecnici e ai partner aziendali.

• Aiuterai con compiti amministrativi, organizzativi e contabili per il Team dei Diritti di Brevetto e Design.

Più su di te:

• Laurea in ingegneria elettrica, fisica o esperienza lavorativa equivalente e background in almeno uno dei seguenti campi tecnici: comunicazione wireless, elaborazione dei segnali e reti neurali.

• Esperienza aziendale nella pratica internazionale dei brevetti o nella gestione di progetti.

• Aderenza forte per estrarre e comunicare concetti tecnici e legali in modo chiaro e conciso.

• Capacità di identificare, valutare e spiegare questioni relative ai brevetti e fornire consigli IP ai stakeholders interni.

• Esperienza nella ricerca e nella raccolta di informazioni da database e registri IP.

• Eccellenti abilità scritte e orali in inglese e tedesco.

Più su di ciò che offriamo:

Come uno dei principali fornitori di cure per l'ascolto al mondo con sede in Svizzera, ci impegniamo a creare una cultura inclusiva in cui puoi bilanciare una carriera di successo con la tua vita fuori dal lavoro grazie al nostro modello di lavoro ibrido flessibile. descriptionByLocale.en:
About Sonova

Sonova is a global leader in innovative hearing care solutions: from personal audio devices and wireless communication systems to audiological care services, hearing aids and cochlear implants. Sonova operates through 3 businesses
- Hearing Instruments (Wholesale + Retail), Consumer Hearing and Cochlear Implants – and the core brands Phonak, Unitron, AudioNova, Sennheiser (under license) and Advanced Bionics as well as recognized regional brands. The Group’s globally diversified sales and distribution channels serve an ever-growing consumer base in more than 100 countries. In financial year 2024/205, Sonova Group achieved consolidated sales of over CHF 3.8 billion with adjusted EBITA of CHF 807.8 million.

About the role

The Director Customer Support is globally responsible for designing, standardizing, and continuously improving the customer service framework. Acting as Global Process Owner, this role defines the support models, structures, and governance that enable regions and countries to deliver accessible, predictable, and customer-friendly service. By balancing global consistency with local flexibility, the Director ensures customer service is scalable, efficient, and positioned as a differentiator for Sonova. This role champions service excellence and empowers customer-facing teams worldwide to deliver seamless experiences that increase satisfaction, loyalty, and efficiency.

Key responsibilities:

Global Process Ownership & Governance

• Define and govern global customer service processes, including escalation models, response standards, and knowledge management frameworks.

• Build global SOPs, playbooks, and standard work to ensure consistent service across all markets.

• Act as Global Process Owner, accountable for end-to-end customer service delivery and performance across regions.

Support Model Design & Optimization

• Design and optimize support structures (e.g., tiered models, remote vs. field service, multilingual capabilities) to balance scale, cost, and customer satisfaction.

• Partner with local and regional leaders to adapt models for market-specific needs while protecting global standards.

• Ensure support models are scalable and flexible to address future growth and changing customer expectations.

Service Excellence & Culture

• Drive a customer-centric service culture, embedding excellence into daily operations through training, coaching, and performance management.

• Provide global playbooks, best practices, and frameworks that enable customer-facing roles to deliver consistently high-quality service.

• Act as role model and champion for customer-first mindset across service teams worldwide.

Performance & KPI Framework

• Establish, track, and govern global KPIs for customer service (e.g., First-Time Resolution, Time to Respond, Service Satisfaction, Complaint Resolution).

• Provide transparent reporting and dashboards that support global oversight and local accountability.

• Partner with local leaders to analyze results, identify performance gaps, and implement improvement actions.

Scalability & Infrastructure

• Build scalable capabilities for customer service delivery, ensuring systems, tools, and processes are aligned across markets.

• Partner with IT and Digital to deploy knowledge management platforms, automation, and AI-powered solutions that reduce manual work and improve responsiveness.

• Continuously enhance efficiency and cost-effectiveness while safeguarding service quality.

About you

• University degree in business administration, project management, marketing, communications or related field.

• 8–10 years in customer service leadership with global or multi-market scope.

• Exceptional customer-orientation and a strong background in support model design and optimization, balancing global consistency with local flexibility.

• Demonstrable experience in leading and designing customer support / service strategies and integrating new solutions (digital, AI) to automate and enhance service.

• Strategically thinker with strong analytical/problem-solving skills.

• Entrepreneurial mindset, including a high tolerance for ambiguity and penchant for experimentation.

• Pronounced hands-on mentality and bias towards action.

• Strong continuous improvement mindset and capability to develop and improve processes whilst juggling competing project timelines.

• Ability to effect change, leading people, process, and technology in a dynamic and complex operating environment.

• A proactive collaborator who enjoys working across functions and leading others indirectly within a matrixial organization.

• Strong stakeholder management with a proven ability to influence leadership up to CxO level.

Informazioni su Sonova Sonova è un leader globale nelle soluzioni innovative per l'assistenza all'udito: dai dispositivi audio personali e sistemi di comunicazione wireless ai servizi di assistenza audiologica, apparecchi acustici e impianti cocleari. Sonova opera attraverso 3 attività - Strumenti acustici (all'ingrosso + al dettaglio), Apparecchi acustici per consumatori e Impianti cocleari - e i marchi principali Phonak, Unitron, AudioNova, Sennheiser (su licenza) e Advanced Bionics, nonché marchi regionali riconosciuti. I canali di vendita e distribuzione diversificati a livello globale del Gruppo servono una base di consumatori in continua crescita in più di 100 paesi. Nell’anno finanziario 2024/205, il Gruppo Sonova ha realizzato un fatturato consolidato di oltre 3,8 miliardi di franchi con un EBITA rettificato di 807,8 milioni di franchi. Informazioni sul ruolo Il Direttore dell'assistenza clienti è responsabile a livello globale della progettazione, standardizzazione e miglioramento continuo della struttura del servizio clienti. Agendo come Global Process Owner, questo ruolo definisce i modelli di supporto, le strutture e la governance che consentono alle regioni e ai paesi di fornire un servizio accessibile, prevedibile e orientato al cliente. Bilanciando la coerenza globale con la flessibilità locale, il Direttore garantisce che il servizio clienti sia scalabile, efficiente e posizionato come elemento di differenziazione per Sonova. Questo ruolo promuove l'eccellenza del servizio e consente ai team a contatto con i clienti in tutto il mondo di offrire esperienze fluide che aumentano la soddisfazione, la lealtà e l'efficienza. Responsabilità principali: proprietà e governance dei processi globali
• Definire e governare i processi globali del servizio clienti, inclusi modelli di escalation, standard di risposta e strutture di gestione della conoscenza.
• Costruire SOP globali, playbook e lavoro standard per garantire un servizio coerente in tutti i mercati.
• Agire come proprietario globale del processo, responsabile della fornitura e delle prestazioni del servizio clienti end-to-end in tutte le regioni. Progettazione e ottimizzazione del modello di supporto
• Progettare e ottimizzare le strutture di supporto (ad esempio, modelli a più livelli, assistenza remota o sul campo, funzionalità multilingue) per bilanciare scala, costi e soddisfazione del cliente.
• Collaborare con i leader locali e regionali per adattare i modelli alle esigenze specifiche del mercato, proteggendo al contempo gli standard globali.
• Garantire che i modelli di supporto siano scalabili e flessibili per affrontare la crescita futura e le mutevoli aspettative dei clienti. Eccellenza e cultura del servizio
• Promuovere una cultura del servizio incentrata sul cliente, incorporando l'eccellenza nelle operazioni quotidiane attraverso formazione, coaching e gestione delle prestazioni.
• Fornire playbook globali, best practice e strutture che consentano ai ruoli a contatto con i clienti di fornire un servizio costantemente di alta qualità.
• Agire come modello e sostenitore della mentalità incentrata sul cliente tra i team di assistenza di tutto il mondo. Prestazioni e framework KPI
• Stabilire, monitorare e governare i KPI globali per il servizio clienti (ad esempio, risoluzione al primo tentativo, tempo di risposta, soddisfazione del servizio, risoluzione dei reclami).
• Fornire report e dashboard trasparenti che supportino la supervisione globale e la responsabilità locale.
• Collaborare con i leader locali per analizzare i risultati, identificare le lacune prestazionali e implementare azioni di miglioramento. Scalabilità e infrastruttura
• Costruisci capacità scalabili per l'erogazione del servizio clienti, garantendo che sistemi, strumenti e processi siano allineati tra i mercati.
• Collaborare con l'IT e il digitale per implementare piattaforme di gestione della conoscenza, automazione e soluzioni basate sull'intelligenza artificiale che riducono il lavoro manuale e migliorano la reattività.
• Migliorare continuamente l'efficienza e il rapporto costo-efficacia salvaguardando la qualità del servizio. Informazioni su di te
• Laurea in economia aziendale, gestione di progetti, marketing, comunicazione o settori correlati.
• 8–10 anni di leadership nel servizio clienti con ambito globale o multimercato.
• Eccezionale orientamento al cliente e un forte background nella progettazione e ottimizzazione dei modelli di supporto, bilanciando la coerenza globale con la flessibilità locale.
• Esperienza dimostrabile nella guida e progettazione di strategie di assistenza/servizio clienti e nell'integrazione di nuove soluzioni (digitali, AI) per automatizzare e migliorare il servizio.
• Pensatore strategico con forti capacità analitiche/di risoluzione dei problemi.
• Mentalità imprenditoriale, inclusa un'elevata tolleranza per l'ambiguità e una propensione alla sperimentazione.
• Mentalità pratica e propensione all'azione pronunciata.
• Forte mentalità di miglioramento continuo e capacità di sviluppare e migliorare i processi destreggiandosi tra le tempistiche dei progetti concorrenti.
• Capacità di attuare il cambiamento, guidando persone, processi e tecnologia in un ambiente operativo dinamico e complesso.
• Un collaboratore proattivo a cui piace lavorare trasversalmente alle funzioni e guidare gli altri indirettamente all'interno di un'organizzazione a matrice.
• Forte gestione delle parti interessate con una comprovata capacità di influenzare la leadership fino al livello CxO. <div dir="auto" style=" larghezza:calc(100% - 16px) !importante;"

descriptionByLocale.de:
In dieser Funktion bist du als Technischer Spezialist Produktion TSP (m/w/d) ein zentraler Bestandteil unseres Support-Teams in der Elektronikfertigung.

Du stellst die Anlagenverfügbarkeit durch vorbeugende Wartung sicher, minimierst Stillstände durch nachhaltige Instandhaltungsstrategien und behebst Störungen inklusive Ursachenanalyse. Dabei treibst du kontinuierliche Verbesserungen im Bereich Maintenance voran und entwickelst deine Fachkenntnisse (z. B. im TPS) stetig weiter.

Als technische Schnittstelle zwischen Produktion, Engineering und Entwicklung unterstützt du die Fachbereiche, berätst bei technischen Fragestellungen und wirkst an der Optimierung unserer Anlagen mit.

Mehr über die Rolle

• Sicherstellung der Anlagenverfügbarkeit durch vorbeugende Wartung von Anlagen, Betriebs- und Prüfmitteln

• Minimierung von Stillständen durch nachhaltige Instandhaltungsstrategien und Unterstützung der Maschinenbediener bei grundlegenden Wartungsaufgaben

• Analyse und Behebung von Störungen in der Produktion inklusive Ursachenanalyse

• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung (Continuous Improvement) im Bereich Maintenance

• Technische Schnittstelle zwischen Produktion, Engineering, Entwicklung sowie weiteren Fachbereichen (R&D, NPI, B&I)

• Technische Beratung und Unterstützung der Produktionsabteilungen sowie Mitwirkung bei der Optimierung von Anlagen

• Koordination, Dokumentation und Überwachung von Instandhaltungsmaßnahmen (inkl. LEXA) sowie Einhaltung von Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsvorschriften

• Verwaltung und Beschaffung von Ersatzteilen sowie Unterstützung bei der Weiterentwicklung automatisierter Anlagen und Pikettdienst bei Bedarf

Mehr über dich

• Abgeschlossene technische Berufsbildung (EFZ) im elektronischen Bereich (z. B. Automatiker, Polymechaniker, Elektroniker)

• Erfahrung in der Elektronikproduktion, idealerweise mit Kenntnissen in Lean Management, Supply Chain und SMD/Flip-Chip-Bestückung

• Gute Übersicht über die gesamte Produktionskette sowie idealerweise Erfahrung in der Automatisierung oder Halbleiterfertigung

• Ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis, schnelle Auffassungsgabe und bereichsübergreifendes Denken

• Hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein sowie strukturierte und verantwortungsvolle Arbeitsweise

• Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Schulungen sowie in der Einhaltung von Prozessen und Qualitätsstandards

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Gute PC-Anwenderkenntnisse (MS Office 365); SAP-Kenntnisse von Vorteil

Mehr über unser Angebot

Als eines der weltweit führenden Unternehmen im Bereich Hörlösungen mit Hauptsitz in der Schweiz legen wir großen Wert auf eine inklusive und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur.

Wir bieten dir:

• Strukturierte Einarbeitung sowie gezielte interne und externe Weiterbildungen

• Individuelle Entwicklungs- und Wachstumsmöglichkeiten

• Ein modernes Produktionsumfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswege

• Die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Prozesse aktiv mitzugestalten
